4483210.name: The Too-Cute Girl Who Moved in Next Door

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a 3D romance simulation game.

Explore the world using point-and-click controls to move, investigate locations, and interact with the heroine.

By completing a variety of missions and mini-games, you can earn money and gradually build your relationship by increasing the heroine’s affection and trust.

■ Pure Romance Route

What begins as an act of revenge slowly changes into something more.
As Yuki spends time with Keiko, he gradually finds himself falling for her.
Keiko, too, becomes unable to suppress her growing feelings through their interactions.
Confess your love and work toward marriage.
This is the game’s main storyline.

■ Revenge Route

Introduce Keiko to a new part-time job in the nightlife industry.
Record key moments of her new life and compile them into a video message.
Send it as a final statement to the former boss you despise.

Various events related to the main heroine will occur

Your affection or love rating will increase depending on your choices during the drama

(Be warned - making wrong choices will raise your criminal coefficient...

Additionally, there are many mini-games available

Some help you earn money, while others boost your affection or love ratings

Raising your affection or love ratings through these will advance the main story

Cabaret Hostess: Anri

The shop's number one attraction

At home, she spends her time watching anime, playing video games, or just lounging around lazily.

Her room is a mess

Protagonist: Hieda Yuki

Worked at a notorious black IT company called Nuitter Japan

Left due to workplace harassment by her boss, Iruma Ichiro

Now works as a part-time job-hopper

Looks like a typical playboy, but surprisingly has good common sense

store_data.about_the_game:
Something is off.

It starts like any other block-stacking puzzle game. A 10-wide grid. Seven falling pieces. You clear lines, the speed picks up, and everything feels exactly the way you'd expect.

Then the grid gets wider.

Not all at once. Not with any warning. Just... one more column. Then another. The field keeps growing as you play, stretching into something far beyond what you signed up for. By the time you notice, you're already deep into it.

That's Megaris.

Easy to pick up. Hard to put down.

The core is simple and satisfying: rotate, drop, clear. But the expanding grid changes everything. Strategies that worked five minutes ago fall apart when you're suddenly dealing with 30 columns. Adapting on the fly is the whole game.

More than one way to play

Megaris ships with over 50 gameplay combinations across multiple game modes, board types, and difficulty settings. Some of these are unlocked through play, rewarding dedication with new ways to challenge yourself.

Not all of them are easy to find. And more are coming.

Built for replayability

  • Detailed statistics tracking across every session

  • Separate local high score leaderboards for each mode and difficulty combination

  • 100+ achievements, from approachable milestones to long-term goals that will take serious commitment

  • Unlockable content tied to how you play, not how much you pay

  • Full keyboard and controller support with remappable controls

A living game

Megaris is actively developed. New modes, features, and surprises are in the works. The game you buy GET FOR FREE today will keep growing, just like the grid.

4484350.name: Hatarake! - Working Hard! Even though I getting isekai'd!

store_data.about_the_game:
He gave his life to his job but got nothing in return.

Overworked, exhausted, and forgotten.

His story should have ended on a cold city street.

But a god intervenes.

“All your hard work will be rewarded.”

Reborn in Xelia, a world of magic and monsters, he’s granted a second chance.

To build a new life, and finally fight for his own happiness.


 

Build Your Life From Scratch

Plant and harvest crops, raise livestock, fish in quiet rivers, mine for rare ores, forage in the wild, or take on part-time jobs around town.

Whether you prefer peaceful farm life or chasing profit, there are countless ways to earn a living and grow your dream homestead at your own pace.


Create the Home You Deserve

Turn your hard-earned coin into comfort and style.

Upgrade your farm, decorate your house with furniture, and life a wonderful life.


Life Is More Than Work

Slow down and enjoy the simple joys of village life.

Talk to villager, build friendships, experience heartwarming and hilarious cutscenes, celebrate seasonal festivals, and maybe even find someone special to share your new life with.

Because this time, you’re not just working to survive.

You’re living.

 


[-]Classic farming games with less stress.

[-]Don't like farming? Don't force yourself! There are plenty of ways to earn coins!

[-]Fight monster in dungeon with Action RPG battle system! (not mandatory)

[-]Explore dungeon, solve (fairly easy) puzzle and claim treasure!

[-]There are different festivals every season so you don't get bored.

[-]Three potential wives you could marry. (who could even have children)

[-]Buy empty land, invite (force) people to join and now your empty land is not so empty anymore!.

[-]No main quest = no restriction! Play however you want.

store_data.about_the_game:
FLESH CANCER is a boomer-shooter FPS made in the ID Tech 2 engine, focused on fast-paced gameplay, unnatural environments, and old-school violence.

Wield unique and satisfying weapons such as a double-barrel shotgun, a napalm launcher, and even a skull infused with a strange energy.

Fight enemies ranging from cannibal cultists and terrorists to grotesque aberrations — and even a walking bomb built by a seven-year-old child.


In 1985, after the fall of the military dictatorship in Brazil, an unknown cult begins to form. They are known for their belief that there is another world inhabited by an unknown being who lives inside a skinless humanoid, hopeless and empty. After two years, the cult manages to open a portal to this world in the center of a small city known for its people having no faith or hope. The portal is opened with the goal of granting this being more power, giving it more life and strength.

In a forest near the city lives a man who fought against the dictatorship. After the conflict, he isolated himself from society because of the crimes he committed. When he learns about what the cult has done, he heads to the city to stop it. MAKE IT RAIN FLESH, ORGANS, AND BLOOD LIKE NEVER BEFORE.

“What is your limit?”

store_data.about_the_game:
Nocturnal Terror is a first-person survival horror experience set in a decaying world where something festers beneath a forgotten palace. A slow, organic corruption spreads through the land—warping environments, distorting minds, and pulling people toward an inevitable fate.

You navigate this fragile world by scavenging resources, managing your physical and mental state, and interacting with individuals who cling desperately to what little they have left. Their attachments keep them human—but nothing lasts forever.

Every choice carries weight. What you preserve, what you sacrifice, and who you help will shape how long you endure in a place where decay is constant, and survival is never guaranteed.

Key Features

  • Tense Survival Systems – Manage health, vitality, and psychological strain in a hostile, resource-scarce environment.

  • Decay-Driven World – Witness environments and characters deteriorate over time, affecting gameplay and outcomes.

  • Meaningful Interactions – Build relationships with characters whose survival depends on their fading attachments.

  • Exploration & Atmosphere – Uncover a layered, oppressive world centered around a mysterious palace.

store_data.about_the_game:
STEP INTO THE WORLD OF SPRIGHT

The deeper you descend into the abyss, the more the world twists against you—paths splinter, enemies grow stronger, and the darkness swallows what little guidance remains. Starting at surface level - getting lost is common, and some who wander too far down never find their way back...

THE DEEP SEA EXPLORER

Ancient diving suits, pressure-resistant gear, and relic-hunting technology allow explorers to survive the crushing depths below. Every expedition is a descent into forgotten ruins and hostile waters where few return unchanged.

SPRIGHT IS DESIGNED WITH DIFFICULTY IN MIND

Combat is sharp, aggressive, and movement-driven. Slash through enemies, hammer armored foes, parry deadly attacks, and dash through danger before the depths close in around you. 

Every fight rewards timing, precision, and control — whether you’re dueling hostile explorers, surviving ambushes, or breaking through the creatures guarding forgotten relics; and the lower you go, the harder it gets. Being underleveled is easy!

THE JOURNEY BELOW

  • Slash, hammer, parry, dash, and outmaneuver enemies in fast 2D combat

  • Explore vast handcrafted rooms, ruins, wild zones, and lost corridors

  • Take elevators from the depths into strange new areas — even beyond the sea!

  • Complete timed challenges that test movement, routing, and mastery

  • Meet NPCs, take on missions, uncover quests, and piece together hidden stories

  • Forge and upgrade your tools to survive deeper forbidden zones

  • Swim, dash, warp through space, and discover secret routes

  • Find shortcuts, relics, Crown markers, and optional paths built for curious players

Continuing the story from the first part, this sequel sees our little fairy return in an amazing new style. In Hoa 2, our courageous protagonist sets forth in a vibrant 3D world, interacting with nature, partnering with fascinating creatures and discovering new secrets and abilities in their quest to aid an old friend.

Be immersed in breathtaking visuals:

Hoa 2 takes you into a bigger world, yet still stunning to behold. Experience the signature beautiful hand-painted art-style, now in 3D.

Enjoy an outstanding audio experience:

Relax and unwind as you move through each amazing area, accompanied by soul-touching music, composed by the award-winning team from Hoa 1.

Ally with nature to solve puzzles:

Progressing through the world will require help, and the creatures of the world not only guide you but, over time, teach you wondrous new abilities that will change the way you explore. Work with them to solve light-hearted but engaging puzzles as you progress through the gorgeous areas.

Go for achievements & rewards:

Hoa 2 features many challenging achievements & ultra-cute costumes for you to collect. Explore the world, discover secrets, and challenge yourself with fun & addictive minigames to unlock these rewards.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build, configure, and manage your own data center down to the smallest detail!

Hosting Simulator is not just a simple management game; it is a technical simulation where hardware precision meets the reality of server operations. Start with an empty, dusty room and evolve it into a global data center while battling customer demands, electricity bills, and overheating hardware.

KEY FEATURES

  • Total Hardware Freedom: Manually place rack cabinets, generators, routers, and cooling units anywhere in the room.

  • Modular Machine Building: Don’t just buy servers—build them! Select the right CPU and add enough RAM, HDDs, and a reliable PSU into the motherboard.

  • Graph-Based Cabling Simulation: Connect your devices with realistic network (CAT6) and power cables. Watch the animated data flow and ensure every machine receives both power and internet.

  • Interactive Operating Systems: Connect to any of your servers' monitors! Install Windows Server or Ubuntu Linux, navigate the file system, and use real commands in the virtual Terminal or CMD.

  • Dynamic Economy (SLA): Accept hosting contracts. Whether it’s a small Minecraft server or a large corporate database, maintain the agreed uptime or face heavy penalties.

  • Critical Systems Management: Watch the temperature! Without proper industrial cooling, your servers will crash above 85°C. Monitor Watt consumption and ensure stable power with generators and UPS units.

TECHNICAL DEPTH

In this game, every element is interconnected: more RAM means more heat and power consumption, while a poorly designed network leads to dissatisfied clients. Whether you choose Easy mode for a relaxing experience or Hard for a brutal challenge, Hosting Simulator will test your logic and technical expertise.

STEAM INTEGRATION

  • Auto-Save: Set the frequency of background saves so not a single bit of your progress is lost.

  • DLC Support: Customize your facility with exclusive content, such as digital RGB Gamer Racks.

Ready to boot? The fate of your data center is in your hands.

TECHNICAL DEPTH

In this game, every element is interconnected: more RAM means more heat and power consumption, while a poorly designed network leads to dissatisfied clients. Whether you choose Easy mode for a relaxing experience or Hard for a brutal challenge, Hosting Simulator will test your logic and technical expertise.

STEAM INTEGRATION

  • Auto-Save: Set the frequency of background saves so not a single bit of your progress is lost.

  • DLC Support: Customize your facility with exclusive content, such as digital RGB Gamer Racks.

Ready to boot? The fate of your data center is in your hands.

store_data.about_the_game:
The network never sleeps. Neither does the corruption.

You’re running in a system that’s coming apart. Nodes flicker. Data bleeds. Enemies are firewalls, cores, and void mites—each with a tell before they strike. Your only edge is your deck: attacks that hit hard, blocks that hold the line, and data cards that draw, discard, and rewrite the fight.

Build your stack. Start with basics. Combine them into Advanced, Master, and Precision cards. Spend Power Orbs at the Workshop to craft exactly what your run needs. Every map you clear makes the next one harder—and every loss can send you back one difficulty to earn more orbs and try again.

Read the system. Enemies telegraph attacks, blocks, and debuffs. Plan around their intents, break their block, and watch for Glitch, ensnare, and clones. One misread and the run is over.

Loop until you break. There’s no final boss that ends the game. Difficulty climbs with every map you complete. How far can you go before the network overwhelms you?

Infinite roguelike deckbuilder • Tech/glitch world • Craft and upgrade cards • Scaling difficulty and optional “one difficulty back” on death • One run, no ceiling.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to StarLand! Learn all about the characters, gameplay, and other things right down here!

MAIN GAMEPLAY:

You play as the happiest star of all, named Jimmy. He is on a quest to save the people and town he loves so dearly. Jimmy can Run, Jump, Dash and Glide around the map to get where he needs. Platform around many different landscapes, such as Forest, Desert, Snow and even a Volcano. Jimmy not only has to defeat the main villain, Timmy, but he also has to help the innocent civilian's of StarLand with their regular day-to-day issues... But above all, use everything at your disposal to stop Timmy and his army of Nova's 

ABOUT JIMMY:

Jimmy is the happiest star alive. He is the leader and mayor of StarLand and has been for many many years. He is a fun, charming, and obviously very cheerful star who would do anything for those he loves. Although he has immense strength, he will ALWAYS use his powers for good and to overcome all evil. He believes if he can retain his mayor status in StarLand, he can really make a difference for those around him.

ABOUT TIMMY: 

Timmy is the most angry star alive. He always wanted to be the leader of StarLand but due to his emotional issues, he was never elected. Because of this, he chooses to attempt to take the town by force, creating an army of corrupted stars called Nova's. He is a very smart star and will try his very best to take what isn't his... wait, do i smell.. peanuts?

Main Story:

Timmy attempts to take over StarLand by force using his very own army. When Jimmy learns of this, he ventures out across the vast and unknown lands to try and stop Timmy. He knows he needs to be quick about it, or else StarLand could suffer greatly! He has to overcome all odds and do what was once thought to be impossible by everybody else... but does he have the guts to defeat his own brother?

So, think you have what it takes to save StarLand? Find out if you wish, and above all else... Good Luck :)

store_data.about_the_game:
Synopsis

In a world where old legends have been forgotten, the hunter Victoria works in the shadows, eliminating the last remnants of the vampire bloodlines.

One night, she receives a new mission: infiltrate a secluded Victorian mansion deep in the woods and rescue a young woman named Eleanor, kidnapped by an ancient vampire who has awakened once more. Upon arrival, Victoria discovers the mansion is far more than a simple refuge — it is a sanctuary of darkness, infested with vampires, ghouls, and bloodthirsty creatures.

Eleanor, weakened but determined, manages to escape her cell and crosses paths with Victoria, forming a fragile and uneasy alliance. Together, they must survive, push through decaying corridors, solve ancient mechanisms, and confront the horrors lurking in every corner.

Explore oppressive environments, solve environmental puzzles, and carefully manage your resources: ammunition is scarce, light is vital, and every encounter matters. Combine a variety of weapons and tools to adapt to unpredictable enemies, or team up in local split-screen co-op to face the horror together.

Survive. Cooperate. Uncover the truth.

Key Features

Modernized Classic Survival Horror

Explore dark, oppressive environments where danger may hide around every corner. Constant tension and vulnerability are at the heart of the experience.

Third-Person Combat

Face grotesque creatures using a variety of weapons and tools. Every enemy encounter demands strategy, positioning, and steady nerves.

Character-Driven Narrative

A story centered on the evolving relationship between its protagonists, where choices, the past, and emotional tension grow alongside the danger.

Local Split-Screen Co-op

Experience the full journey with another player. Coordinate strategies, share resources, and face the horror as a team.

Environment-Driven Puzzles

Solve environmental and mechanical puzzles to progress. Observation, logic, and exploration are essential.

Resource Management

Ammunition is limited, healing is scarce, and every item counts. Smart inventory management can mean the difference between life and death.

store_data.about_the_game:
Flow: The Tidal Whispers is a dramatic platformer built for the original 8-bit NES hardware — now on Steam.

Explore a mysterious island during a single night as Lyra, a quiet traveler sent to restore balance before sunrise.
Precise controls and carefully crafted screens deliver a classic platforming challenge where every death becomes a step toward mastery.

Meet quirky rivals drawn to the island for reasons of their own.
Your interactions with them matter.

In Flow, your reflexes matter, but so does your empathy.
Kindness can ease the path ahead… while cruelty may awaken chaos.


Features

• A modern challenging precision platformer built to run on real NES
• A narrative journey with memorable and funny characters
• Dialogue choices that can influence the difficulty of the adventure
• Hidden screens and secrets for players who dare to explore

A true NES game

Flow: The Tidal Whispers was developed using real NES constraints and is fully compatible with original hardware.
The Steam version includes the ROM, so you can also play it on emulators or flash cartridges.

A small note from the developer

You will fail. Many times. That’s how this game works.
You’ll meet strange characters, face strange situations, and probably laugh at least once along the way.

Fail fast. Get back up faster. And keep smiling.

store_data.about_the_game:
Northhold 

A peaceful little settlement in the far north where everything is going great, right up until winter shows up and reminds you that optimism is not a resource.

In Northhold you’ll assign villagers to jobs, expand your town, and build satisfying production chains that turn “we have some wood” into “we might actually survive this.” The warm seasons are for growth. The cold season is for panic-management.

When you finally reach your limits, Found a Saga: reset your settlement, earn permanent legacy upgrades, and start a new run with fresh choices that change how you play.

What you’ll do

  • Run a growing settlement with worker assignments, upgrades, and expanding infrastructure

  • Build production chains that reward planning and optimization

  • Prepare for winter as production drops, consumption rises, and firewood suddenly becomes priceless

  • Manage morale and stability. Happy villagers work better, and they’re less likely to give up mid-winter

  • Found a Saga (prestige) to unlock lasting bonuses and new run modifiers that keep each run interesting

  • Enjoy a clean, text-forward UI built for players who like clarity, numbers, and smart decisions

Northhold is for players who enjoy strategy, management, and that very specific feeling of "I should’ve stockpiled more food."

store_data.about_the_game:
"This is an early Alpha build. Major content updates are actively in development."

Wispip's Siege is a 2D action-adventure siege sandbox set in a dark, procedurally generated world. Descend from the perilous surface through underground caverns, deep ruins, and the deadly Abyss — each layer more dangerous and rewarding than the last.

There is no crafting. Everything you need comes from the enemies you slay.

Explore. Loot. Siege. Survive.

The world is yours to discover — but its greatest rewards are locked behind its greatest dangers. Hunt down rare drops, secure checkpoints, and push deeper into the Abyss to find the gear that will change everything.

Core Features

Drop-Based Progression Six tiers of loot — Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and the ultra-rare Mythic — all earned in combat. No grinding menus. No crafting tables. Kill enemies, take their gear, and get stronger.

Procedurally Generated World Every run generates a unique world across four distinct biome layers: Surface, Underground, Deep, and the Abyss. Explore at your own pace or push hard for the endgame.

Castle Siege Capture a castle using a Siege Scroll — rare drops from the strongest enemies in the Abyss. Once the castle is yours, the real fight begins.

100-Wave Defense After capturing a castle, survive 100 waves of relentless invaders. Only then will you face the Final Boss — and only a Mythic weapon can bring it down.

Checkpoints & Teleport Discover checkpoints throughout the world to anchor your progress. Fast-travel between them via teleport — though the cooldown will keep you honest.

Food & Survival On the surface, food pickups keep you alive. Let your food meter run dry and your HP starts draining. Manage your resources or die.

5 Save Slots Pick up where you left off across up to five independent save files, each showing your power level, items found, and last played date.

Expect rough edges, frequent updates, and a game that grows with your feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the lost dwarven city of Direhold, a labyrinth locked by esoteric runes and haunted by sinister creatures. In Lock & Stone, you must combine puzzle-solving deduction skills with survival-horror combat prowess.

The halls are very interconnected so you will need to keep careful notes on where to return in this metroidvania environment. Uncovering information or a obtaining powers can unlock new areas or reach items back where you previously explored. There are always more secrets to uncover.

To survive, you must use the power of Runes. Each Rune Slate you uncover has a hidden ability that will allow you to survive the dark city. Some slates can allow you to open up locked doors, or blast enemies with flames.

Search the environment for information, decipher the hidden codes, and apply your Rune Slates to access the locks.

Direhold itself is a puzzle to solve. Exploring pathways, understanding the environment, and learning about the lore will allow you to access its secrets.

store_data.about_the_game:
ENTER THE BAYOU… OR BE CONSUMED BY IT

Curse of the Bayou is a fast-paced Roguelite Bullet Hell where quick reflexes, powerful builds, and pure survival instinct are the only things standing between you and death.

Venture deep into a cursed swamp corrupted by dark voodoo magic, fight through relentless hordes of twisted creatures, and confront the one responsible for it all: the Voodoo Master who kidnapped your dog for a sinister ritual.

The Bayou is alive…

And it wants you dead.

RECLAIM WHAT WAS TAKEN FROM YOU

Descend into the depths of the haunted Bayou, where every new area becomes more dangerous than the last.

Face waves of enemies, storms of projectiles, and nightmarish creatures born from voodoo curses.
Every run is different — new rooms, new challenges, and new chances to create devastating combinations of abilities.

The deeper you go, the more brutal the fight becomes.

And the stronger you grow, the closer you get to saving your companion.

ADAPT OR SINK INTO THE SWAMP

The Bayou shows no mercy.

Collect resources, discover cursed powers, and create unique builds every run.

Adapt your playstyle, combine upgrades, and turn your character into a storm of destruction in the heart of the swamp.

But be warned…

The swamp is watching.

KEY FEATURES

• Intense Bullet Hell combat against hordes of cursed creatures
• Roguelite progression system with upgrades between runs
• Dozens of upgrades and abilities to create unique builds
• Enemies inspired by voodoo folklore and swamp horrors
• Powerful bosses guarding the darkest secrets of the Bayou
• Procedural generation, ensuring every run feels different

THE VOODOO MASTER AWAITS

Something terrible is being prepared deep within the swamp.

Your dog has been taken…
And you are the only thing standing between him and a ritual that should never be completed.

Enter the Bayou.
Fight the horrors within.
Break the curse.

And bring your friend home.

store_data.about_the_game:
A battle is won before it begins.

Ratnik is a medieval auto battler built around preparation, positioning and counterplay. There is no micromanagement once the fighting starts. No last-second spell saves. No hero abilities.

You build your army.
You deploy your forces.
You press start.

And then your strategy either holds — or collapses.

Tactical Army Composition

Every battle begins in the deployment phase.

You decide how to spend your limited gold, which units to field, and how to position them before the first clash. Each unit has a cost and a deployment cap, forcing meaningful trade-offs instead of simple massing of one type.

Spearmen for cost-efficient frontline pressure
Swordsmen for balanced engagements
Crossbows to increase total damage output
Royal Guards to anchor critical positions
Mounted Knights to disrupt formations with trampling charges
Healers to extend your army’s staying power

Ratnik does not rely on hard counters. Instead, success comes from understanding efficiency, synergy, and battlefield roles. Every unit contributes differently to the overall performance of your army.

There are no permanent stat upgrades. Victory comes from building a composition that performs better, not one that simply looks stronger.

Defeat the Lords

Progression happens through conquest.

Each region is ruled by a Lord with a distinct army composition and battlefield philosophy. Some rely on disciplined infantry lines. Others overwhelm with cavalry charges or ranged pressure.

Defeating a Lord unlocks new units and deeper strategic possibilities — but the next opponent will demand even more refined tactics.

As the campaign advances, battles scale up in size and complexity, culminating in massive clashes where full compositions collide.

Large-Scale Medieval Battles

From early 20v20 engagements to 100v100 warfields, Ratnik delivers large battles without micromanagement.

Fights are designed to resolve decisively — but the outcome is determined entirely by your preparation.

Watch the Plan Unfold

Once the battle begins, you can:

Adjust battle speed
Zoom into the frontline
Pull back for a tactical overview

Whether you want to study positioning or simply watch formations collide, the battlefield is yours to observe.

Key Features

  • Tactical medieval auto battles focused on preparation, not micromanagement

  • Campaign progression through distinct enemy Lords

  • Unlock new units by winning battles

  • Gold-based deployment with strict unit limits

  • Battles that scale from small skirmishes to 100v100 clashes

  • No stat grind — strategy determines victory

  • Adjustable battle speed and free camera control

  • High replayability through different army compositions

store_data.about_the_game:
🧠 The Story

Missing Texture is a psychological horror narrative experience structured into chapters, all accessible from a central Launcher.

The Launcher acts as the core of the Missing Texture universe, allowing you to access every main chapter while keeping your progress unified.

But there is something more.

The story is not told only through the main chapters.

It fragments.
It hides.
It rebuilds itself.

🏚️ An Interconnected Narrative Universe

The saga is divided into:

📖 Main Chapters (Free)

  • Up to 4 planned chapters.

  • The central story of abduction and distorted reality.

  • Direct continuation between episodes.

🧩 Side Games (Some Free, Some Under €5)

  • Narrative expansions.

  • Alternative stories.

  • Perspectives from other characters.

  • Events that connect to the main storyline.

They are not required to understand the story…
but they change how you interpret it.

🏚️ Setting – The House

You are inside what appears to be a normal house.

But something is wrong.

Hallways that don’t align.
Rooms that change.
Doors that appear where nothing stood before.
Textures that disappear.

And someone who lives there.

🔥 Core Gameplay Mechanics

🔐 High-Tension Exploration

  • Full interaction with key objects.

  • Detailed inspection system.

🗝️ Advanced Lockpicking System

  • Dynamic lockpicking minigame.

  • Limited tools.

  • Failure with consequences.

🧠 Dynamic Distortion

  • Real-time visual glitches.

  • Subtle structural changes within the house.

  • Events that do not always repeat in every playthrough.

store_data.detailed_description:
🧠 The Story

Missing Texture is a psychological horror narrative experience structured into chapters, all accessible from a central Launcher.

The Launcher acts as the core of the Missing Texture universe, allowing you to access every main chapter while keeping your progress unified.

But there is something more.

The story is not told only through the main chapters.

It fragments.
It hides.
It rebuilds itself.

🏚️ An Interconnected Narrative Universe

The saga is divided into:

📖 Main Chapters (Free)

  • Up to 4 planned chapters.

  • The central story of abduction and distorted reality.

  • Direct continuation between episodes.

🧩 Side Games (Some Free, Some Under €5)

  • Narrative expansions.

  • Alternative stories.

  • Perspectives from other characters.

  • Events that connect to the main storyline.

They are not required to understand the story…
but they change how you interpret it.

🏚️ Setting – The House

You are inside what appears to be a normal house.

But something is wrong.

Hallways that don’t align.
Rooms that change.
Doors that appear where nothing stood before.
Textures that disappear.

And someone who lives there.

🔐 High-Tension Exploration

  • Full interaction with key objects.

  • Detailed inspection system.

🗝️ Advanced Lockpicking System

  • Dynamic lockpicking minigame.

  • Limited tools.

  • Failure with consequences.

🧠 Dynamic Distortion

  • Real-time visual glitches.

  • Subtle structural changes within the house.

  • Events that do not always repeat in every playthrough.

store_data.about_the_game:
A first-person survival game set in a post-Soviet world devastated by infection and radiation.

This game is currently in active development and available as a pre-alpha build. Some mechanics, visuals, animations, sounds, and gameplay systems are unfinished and may change significantly during development.

A mysterious parasite infected millions of people, triggering global panic. As governments attempted to stop the outbreak, a cult formed around the parasite and sabotaged containment efforts. Attacks on nuclear facilities caused catastrophic meltdowns, spreading radiation across entire regions.

The infected mutated into aggressive creatures, and entire cities were abandoned.

You live far from the original disaster zone — but the consequences have spread everywhere. Supplies are scarce, dangerous creatures roam the land, and abandoned locations hide both valuable resources and deadly threats.

Explore ruined settlements, search for supplies, build a safe base, and fight to survive in a collapsing world.

Survival depends on careful exploration, resource management, and securing safe locations in a hostile environment.

Current State of the Game

The current version contains:

  • Core survival gameplay systems

  • Exploration and scavenging mechanics

  • Basic combat systems

  • Early base building features

  • Prototype locations and enemies

The game may contain:

  • Bugs and technical issues

  • Placeholder assets and unfinished visuals

  • Incomplete balancing

  • Missing content and partially implemented systems

The project will continue to receive major updates during development.

store_data.about_the_game:
Photographs are puzzles.

  • Recreate exact compositions.

  • A frame shows you a scene: two elements together, a creature in a specific pose, a moment that only happens under certain conditions.

  • Figure out where those elements exist together in the world, understand what causes that arrangement, and then engineer the moment.

  • The puzzles are environmental riddles solved through the lens of your camera.

Mastery comes from understanding wildlife.

  • Understand the wildlife's behaviour to engineer exact shots.

  • Earn it through observation and patience.

Observation replaces combat.

  • The challenge is exploration, observation, and understanding, not reflexes.

  • There is no combat, no punishment for failure, and no difficult platforming.

  • The game is easy to pick up but has a high ceiling of mastery based on your eye for composition and your knowledge of the world.

This promotional game for “Vtuber Kinukawa Raspberry” was displayed only during the two-day business days at the WitOne booth at Tokyo Game Show 2023.

It was developed using Action Game Maker MV.

Originally planned for release alongside the fan-favorite murder mystery game “An Important Announcement from Vtuber Kinukawa Raspberry,” it has finally been released.

Use one controller to operate Player 1 Eclair & Player 2 Super Chat Man.

Play both characters solo, or grab a controller and team up with a friend for co-op play.

【Rules】

Collect all 4 types of marksscattered around the concert venue

and deliver them to the stage where Raspberry is waiting!

Each mark is worth 6 to 3 points, and the point value changes each time you play.

If you collect 8 marks while already holding 8, all 8 will become the same mark.

Aim to collect the highest-point mark last before heading to the stage.

Touching a Gremie will make you lose the marks you've collected.

Jump at the right moment to leap over them.

When the timer hits 0, time's up!

Your individual scores and the combined total for both players will be displayed.

store_data.about_the_game:
One Of Us is a real time strategy game with various different game modes to play, in some game modes you'll build a base and units to attack the enemy, and in others you'll have control over just a small squad or single unit to fight it out against all the other squads. The main game from the intro screen is a good place to start if you want a longer game where you build a base, whereas if you want to jump straight into the action trying the Battle Royale mode is a good place to start. 

In the main game, you can choose the AI income multiplier, if you're new to RTS games you probably want to try somewhere low like 0.50x or below, so the enemy doesn't build many units so you can get used to the game. If you've played RTS games before then somewhere around 1.00x would be good, if you're very experienced with RTS games then you can probably challenge yourself to 1.50x and beyond once you've got used to the game. 

One Of Us uses first person style controls by default, so you can move around using WASD, and Q/E to lower and raise your height (build more power plants & comms centers for extra height). You can use TAB when you want to switch between accessing the UI and controlling the first person character. To build from a building, you can left click on the building in first person mode, the game will switch to UI mode automatically so you can choose what you want to build from the UI. You'll need to build refineries to collect the crystals, extra harvesters can be built from the refineries. There are various unit production buildings that you can build units from. 

One useful unit to build is the mobile building platform from the light weapons factory, this allows you to build near it, so move it near another patch of crystals to build a refinery there, or near the enemy base later on to build a unit production building right on the enemy's doorstep. You can also see the enemy's fog of war, so you can hide your new base where the enemy can't see it!

Some of the game modes available: 

- Outbreak, traditional RTS base building battle, against an AI team of zombies. You only have use of infantry in this game mode, and any units lost to the zombies will become zombies themselves so keeping your units alive is very important, the medic may come in useful in this game mode. 

- Mech Survival, traditional RTS base building battle, but you control the game from within the player mech. Which means your view is limited to being close to the ground and your movement speed is slow. This game mode makes controlling a large battlefield more of a challenge. Your player mech also has a health bar, so the AI will attack you personally, you must survive until the end of the match in order to win. 

- Battle Royale, 100 teams of up to 5 squad members fighting it out in a battle royale. Collect crates for extra ammo, units, lives, powerups etc.

- Mech Royale, same as battle royale, but instead of a squad you take control of the player mech in first person shooter mode. 

- Escape The Tide, infantry only squad mode, where you have to fight it out amongst the other teams whilst also racing the tide to get to the highest point on the map so your squad members don't drown. 


I hope you have fun with the game, there's a lot to learn to get really good at the game, but with a few basic controls you should do just fine. In the adaptations menu you'll find various ways of changing the game, such as game modes, control methods, maps, factions, building toggles so you can play as air units only, naval units only, infantry units only etc. There's lots in there to make each game different from the last, get experimenting!

store_data.about_the_game:
Two years ago, dungeons began appearing. Upon a dungeon's inception, some people are dragged in at random. Survival rates are brutally low. Those who do make it out often have changed. Beyond the trauma, they come back stronger because killing monsters inside dungeons grants power.

And yet, some gain something even greater. They are called Awakeners. With the help of magical artifacts found within dungeons, they unlock supernatural skills and abilities.

But even among Awakeners, your situation is clearly out of the ordinary. While many report a purple status screen that quantifies their abilities, nobody ever mentioned it can turn black...

store_data.about_the_game:
This is an arcade experience set in a lush, atmospheric forest where chance encounters lead to intimate rewards. You are a solitary wanderer whose peaceful walks through nature turn into increasingly daring interactions with the women you meet along hidden woodland paths.

The game is not centered on narrative depth or exploration-driven storytelling. Instead, it offers a direct gameplay and reward loop. Each successful stage unlocks progressively more revealing illustrations and short animated scenes featuring your encounters, all archived in a private in-game gallery.

Gameplay – The Encounter System

Each encounter is resolved through an area-control arcade mechanic. You move across the screen, drawing boundaries to capture sections of the image while avoiding roaming obstacles and environmental hazards. Precision and timing are essential. Once the full image is uncovered, an animated version becomes available in your gallery.

Key Features:

  • Reflex-driven arcade mechanics with increasing difficulty.

  • Enchanting forest environments with a sensual atmosphere.

  • A cast of adult female characters encountered throughout your journey.

  • Progressive unlocking of provocative artwork and short animated scenes.

  • Integrated gallery for reviewing unlocked content.

  • Designed exclusively for adult audiences.

store_data.about_the_game:
This journey portrays the uprising of UWirrld Entertainment Recording Studio and more specifically it's owner King Keith.

While seemingly a hip-hop A&R, Manager and Studio owner who signs indie artists and increasing revenue from releasing music and gaining fame, King Keith also hides a secret within that could not only destroy his legacy, but also parts of this world. That secret is Kritical McCoy!

From unknown realms, Krtical McCoy emerges to protect his investments in UWirrld HQ and Earth itself, from urban street foes and unseen spiritual threats, called Entities.

Entities are everywhere! Although unseen by regular humanity, they are within every heated debate, theft, cheat, argument, threats...everywhere. However, being that they are attuned to Earth and Kritical McCoy is not, he can see these entities and obliterate them as well. Although, his mission isn't exactly to "save humanity" but more about saving his empire, with becoming a hero more of an unexpected result.

Some of the features Kritical McCoy may encounter during his journey are:

UWirrld HQ - Your building of operation for hiring new talent, releasing new music and upgrading KM Skills

Open Map - Cross the map at your own leisure and find POI like Da Brickz, Army Base and Boss Fights

KritiCycle - Once unlocked spawn your bike anywhere and cross the map with ease

Transformation - Once unlocked King Keith can enter KM State where he and his bike will transform and become more powerful, faster and...pretty dope

Buy Stuff - Buy weapons, healing items, boost and smoke to keep yourself in good spirits and health

Weapons - Beyond KMs own skills, there are also various melee and ranged weapons at your disposal

So, take the journey along with King Keith and grow your empire all while protecting your assets and, with the help of Kritical McCoy, diminishing the entities ruining not only the world, but your business most importantly!

Mystic Grove is a dark first-person action RPG set in a surreal alien wilderness where magic, dinosaurs, aliens and other hostile creatures collide.

store_data.about_the_game:
One mistake is all it takes.

At the gate of the Inner Circle, every decision you make decides who gains power — and who shouldn’t have it.
Some visitors are lying. Some are dangerous. Some will look completely harmless.

Your job is simple: let the right ones in.
The reality is anything but.

Inspect, Detect, Decide

Analyze visitors through documents, behavior, and interrogation.

Search for inconsistencies, contradictions, and hidden intent. A missing detail or a single hesitation can reveal the truth, or mislead you completely.

Every Decision Has Consequences

Approve the wrong person and you risk losing control.
Detain the wrong one and you punish the innocent.

Visitors will pressure you, manipulate you, and test your judgment.
You will make mistakes and you will have to live with them.

The Protocol Is Not Absolute

The Entry Validation Protocol gives you structure, but it won’t save you.

As you progress, rules become less reliable and cases more complex.
Not everything can be explained. Not everything should be trusted.

At some point, you stop following the system… and start making your own calls.

Progress Deeper Into the System

Earn money, return to your apartment, and invest in upgrades.
Unlock new tools, mechanics, and more demanding inspections.

The better you perform, the more responsibility you gain — and the harder it becomes to walk away.

You Are Being Watched

Your decisions are tracked.
Your performance is judged.
Your loyalty is questioned.

Hold the line.

Or become part of what you’re trying to control.

store_data.about_the_game:
Time to explore this World In Chaos!

Story:

You follow the story of the son of the most famous Royal Knight, Chansus. Trying to live up to his dad's immense legacy is scary, at every step he is told about his dad's great feats. His dad was killed by an Ancient High King called Lothric, and you are sent out by the king to stop him. As you chase him down something nefarious is going on, he's destroying outposts and trying to gain the power of a long-dead eight-headed dragon called Hydranous. Will you be able to stop Lothric? Or are you too late?

About the Dev:

This is a one-man dev team working on making games for the love of making games! I don't believe in early-Access or microtransactions. I just want to create story-driven RPGs! I spent countless hours in game development in my days but this is my first full release! I am absolutely ecstatic to show you what I've made and continue to develop this game with you all

-Dom

Planned Free DLCs:

Great Beasts:

The Great Beasts DLC will be a new story expansion and the second adventure Chansus will embark on! Explore Vivene, a new area in the world filled with immense monsters, but something is a little off. The monsters are getting stronger and people are disappearing. Meet the big game hunters and find out what is happening here (new character unlocked, Game Hunter).

  • Town reputation system changes based on the choices you make

  • Over 6 different classes with very different skill sets

  • An engaging main story that follows a son looking for his dad's killer

  • DLCs added to the game after the release for free

  • Team management systems

  • Character stats change based on many factors

  • Over 500 detailed areas to explore

store_data.about_the_game:
What happens when falling blocks meet platforming? You jump on them.

Rock the Block is a physics-based puzzle platformer where YOU ride on top of falling pieces. Guide your hero across tumbling shapes, leap between blocks as they pile up, and clear filled rows to rack up massive combos.

RIDE THE FALL

Every piece is a platform. Land on a falling block, ride it down, fix the heap before the next one drops. Real 2D physics means pieces tilt, tumble, and stack unpredictably — no two games play the same.

CLEAR ROWS, BUILD COMBOS

Fill a row and watch it shatter. Chain consecutive clears into combos that multiply your score. Every combo triggers screen shake, particle bursts, and satisfying audio feedback. How long can you keep the chain going?

SHAPES KEEP COMING

Start with simple bars and squares, then face hooks, zigzags, stars, spirals, and more as difficulty ramps up. Piece gravity intensifies the longer you survive — how high can you score before the ceiling catches up?

MAKE IT YOURS

Unlock playfield themes as you play. Deck out your game with vibrant color palettes — from Synthwave City to Aurora Borealis to Deep Space.

FEATURES

  • Pure physics gameplay - pieces have real mass, rotation, and momentum

  • Combo system with escalating multipliers and visual feedback

  • Progressive difficulty with increasingly complex shapes

  • Unlockable skins and visual themes

  • One-handed friendly controls

Can you outscore your best? Drop in and find out.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tasty Beverage is a hybrid of Roguelite Action and Incremental Idler where you build your own army of followers to overthrow a corrupt international corporation that secretly runs the world!

Build up your crew, money, influence, and resources. On the way up, you will have different types of competitors: rival crews who want to keep you down, enforcement agencies under the command of your enemies. As your squad's skills and arsenal rise, you may organize your own attacks on enemy safehouses to root them out. Or you can try a more peaceful approach, it's up to you who you want to be!

Choose how you will approach this - Spread your message through music? Cultist Devotion? Or use violent force? There are different paths you could take, and all of them share the same goal - exposing and taking down the dystopian megacorporation.

What Can You Do

Tasty Beverage will receive free updates for a good while. The game will be updated with new features and more things to do that deepen the gameplay and overall feel, while fixing bugs and improving the smoothness of the game. Here is what is available in the current release:

  • Explore a procedurally generated, top-down city where civilians, rivals, and police gradually respond to your actions.

  • Switch between street-level action and a safehouse mode where you plan, recover, and progress your run. You can progress your goals in both of these modes, as you manage risk to not be intercepted by rival crews or the police.

  • Perform legal or illegal actions to gain money, influence, and useful items.

  • Equip your squad with weapons and items.

  • Recruit new members, and choose to take them with you on risky jobs if you feel they are ready.

  • Train squad members to be more useful and stay safe during risky situations.

  • Launch raids on rival headquarters targets, and fight through separate away-mission locations.

  • Defend yourself from enemy raids on your own safehouse.

  • Invest in upgrading your safehouse for extra perks and safeguards from specific risky situations that some factions may sometimes force on you - like air raids event or poison gas event.


    This game was inspired by a classic text-based game Liberal Crime Squad, goal is to make a brand new game that takes the squad management aspects and modernizes it with more action and idler elements for depth and higher intractability. We hope to add a lot more content than what's mentioned above, so keep an eye out for news!

store_data.about_the_game:
You have been granted the privilege to attend a magical institution as a college age student, but that privilege has to be earned every day. Play with up to 4 players in a team and compete with other teams in magical classes and clubs to earn points for your team. The best teams will be allowed to continue to the next game day and study advanced topics. All other teams will have to return to the first game day and start over.

MAGICAL CLASSES

Classes are taught and graded by the teachers of the institute. In every class you will learn a new magical skill and then proceed to apply this skill to earn points for your team. The following subjects are taught at the institute

  • Combative Magic: Learn spells to defend yourself against other witches and wizards

  • Alchemical Studies: Brew magical potions to gain special, temporary buffs

  • Repulsion of Monsters: Study a variety of monsters that you may face when exploring the institute and learn to repel them

  • Manipulative Magic: Study magic that allows you to alter the environment to your advantage

REAL MAGIC

There are no health points. Each spell has a unique effect and you will often have to combine different spells to defeat other players or monsters.

Each spell has a unique pattern that has to be drawn to cast that spell. There are no short-cuts. The better you master the spell patterns, the faster you will be to respond to threats.

EXTRACURRICULAR ACTIVITIES

The institute offers many options to polish your magical skills and gain an advantage over your peers. Points may be earned in clubs such as the Duelling Club. Secrets are hidden throughout the institute, often requiring specific spells or potions to be uncovered.

THE RIGHTEOUS STUDENT

The institute imposes strict rules upon all students. Choose your own path as a model student or trouble maker and live with the consequences.

store_data.about_the_game:
Spinova is a roguelike deckbuilder with slot-machine mechanics set in a world of Slavic mythology. Build a deck of symbols, upgrade their quality and effects, spin the Wheel of Fate, squeeze the maximum multipliers out of every spin and try to reach the Source before the world “recalculates itself with an error” once again.

Luck alone won’t save you here. You decide which symbols enter your deck, which Ancients to summon, which blessings to accept and which oaths to swear. Every choice you make either empowers you – or slowly drags you toward your demise.

Key Features

  • Slot-machine meets deckbuilding

Spin the reels, but prepare in advance: build your deck of symbols – numbers, face cards, artifacts, creatures and unique combo pieces

  • Ancients above the board

Special beings that hover above the grid and change the rules of the game: Zmey Gorynych, Domovoi, Pletelnik and others

  • Blessings and oaths

Powerful passive bonuses and harsh bargains: gain the might of the gods in exchange for restrictions, debuffs and risk

  • Day–night cycle

Every few spins, time of day shifts: during the day symbols gain more points, at night – stronger multipliers. Your choices in the shop and when building your deck depend on the current time

  • Roguelike progression

Each run unlocks new symbols, Ancients, blessings, tools and decks (chess, poker and more)

  • Growth and symbol quality

Your symbols also evolve between runs: their quality increases from simple to carved, wondrous and miraculous, boosting their base points, effects and combo potential in your future games

Every spin is a new challenge to fate. In Spinova you don’t just hope for good luck – you construct it yourself

store_data.about_the_game:
The Orcish Marches - a desolate frontier where a lonely outpost stands between civilization and the horde. As commander of a beleaguered garrison, you must hold the line against waves of orcs, trolls, and goblins that grow fiercer with each passing day. Build walls, man the ballista, and rally your defenders - because when night falls on the Marches, the drums never stop.

Defender of the Orcish Marches is a real-time tower defense game where you command a fortress under siege. Aim your ballista to cut down enemies directly, hire defenders to patrol and fight autonomously, and send menials scrambling to collect the spoils of war before the next wave hits.

Command Your Garrison: Recruit from four distinct defender classes; Engineers who repair battered walls, Pikemen who hold the line in melee, Crossbowmen who rain bolts from tower tops, and Wizards who unleash devastating fire across the battlefield.

Build and Fortify: Construct walls during the night phase with time slowed to a crawl. Recruit your defenses, use your ballista, and spend hard-won gold on upgrades that could mean the difference between survival and ruin.

No Two Runs Are the Same

Choose a Commander class that reshapes your strategy. Collect Relics between nights that combo into powerful synergies. Activate Mutators for brutal challenge modifiers and massive score multipliers. Daily events keep every run unpredictable.

Grow Stronger Between Runs

Earn War Trophies and Legacy Ranks from each attempt. Invest in permanent upgrades - stronger ballista, faster menials, tougher walls - and climb from Recruit to Mythic across dozens of runs. Unlock Achievements to access new Mutators and push your score even higher.

How long can you hold the Marches?

store_data.about_the_game:
Willkommen bei Layer8Problem – dem ultimativen SysAdmin-Simulator!

Du bist Müller, der einzige kompetente IT-Administrator bei GlobalCorp. Dein Job wäre eigentlich großartig und ruhig, wenn da nicht die User wären. Denn das größte Sicherheitsrisiko in jeder Firma sitzt bekanntlich immer 30 cm vor dem Bildschirm (das berüchtigte "Layer 8 Problem").

Dein Ziel? Überlebe den alltäglichen Büro-Wahnsinn bis zum ersehnten Feierabend um 16:30 Uhr. Ohne gefeuert zu werden. Ohne den Serverraum anzuzünden. Und vor allem: Ohne, dass dir der Kaffee ausgeht.

Wie spielt es sich? Das Spiel ist ein satirisches, textbasiertes Entscheidungsspiel mit Ressourcen-Management. Jede E-Mail, jeder Anruf und jeder Gang zur Kaffeemaschine zwingt dich zu Entscheidungen. Gehst du professionell vor oder wählst du den Weg der maximalen Faulheit? Jede deiner Antworten beeinflusst deine drei wichtigsten Überlebens-Werte:

  • Aggro: Dumme Fragen treiben deinen Blutdruck in die Höhe. Erreicht der Wert 100 %, verlierst du die Beherrschung und wirfst deinen Monitor aus dem Fenster.

  • Faulheit: Warum heute arbeiten, was man auch ignorieren kann? Drückst du dich zu oft vor der Arbeit, dann wird der Chef misstrauisch und bestraft dich bei Entscheidungen härter

  • Chef-Radar: Heimlich im Internet surfen oder Kollegen sabotieren ist lustig – bis der Chef es merkt. Ist das Radar voll, wirst du nach einer Abmahnung gefeuert.

    Was erwartet dich im Büro?

  • Absurde Eskalationen: Vom "versehentlich gelöschten Internet" über brennende Drucker bis hin zum nigerianischen Prinzen im Postfach. Du entscheidest, ob du hilfst, trollst oder einfach den Hörer auflegst.

  • Zeitkritische IT-Notfälle: Wenn die Ransomware zuschlägt oder die Kühlung im Serverraum ausfällt, startet der Timer. Löse das Problem, bevor die Zeit abläuft!

  • Das Büro-Ökosystem: Triff auf liebevoll überspitzte Kollegen. Rette Azubi Kevin vor dem totalen Crash, ertrage die Buzzwords von Chantal aus dem Marketing, streite mit Frau Elster aus der Buchhaltung und lerne, dass man Hausmeister Egon besser mit Panzertape besticht.

  • Sammle legendäres Loot: Finde verstaubte USB-Sticks, Energy Drinks oder alte Win95-Handbücher. Mit dem richtigen Item im Inventar lassen sich aussichtslose Situationen "kreativ" lösen (Ein Hammer ist auch nur ein Werkzeug zur Fehlerbehebung)

  • Steam-Features: Schalte 24 Errungenschaften frei, vergleiche deine Fails in den globalen Statistiken mit anderen SysAdmins und nutze plattformübergreifende Cloud-Saves, um deinen Kampf gegen die User nahtlos fortzusetzen.

  • Büro-Politik (Das Ruf-System) Jede deiner Aktionen hat soziale Konsequenzen. Deckst du den Azubi Kevin, wenn er das Netzwerk lahmlegt, oder verpfeifst du ihn an den Chef? Dein Ruf bei den sieben verschiedenen Charakteren – vom mürrischen Hausmeister bis zum cholerischen CEO – bestimmt deinen Arbeitsalltag. Ein hoher Ruf schaltet einzigartige Story-Pfade und Gefälligkeiten frei, während verärgerte Kollegen dir das Leben zur Hölle machen.

  • Wähle deinen Arbeitstag (Schwierigkeitsgrade) Nicht jeder Tag im Büro ist gleich. Passe die Herausforderung an deine Nerven an: Spiele auf "Freitag" (Leicht) für einen entspannten Durchlauf, wähle "Mittwoch" (Normal) für den klassischen Wahnsinn, oder stelle dich dem "Montag" (Schwer) – wo die Ticket-Flut gnadenlos ist, Abmahnungen knapper ausfallen und der Chef keine Fehler verzeiht.

***

Die Idee zu Layer8Problem entstand in einem völlig sinnbefreiten, viel zu langen Kick-Off-Meeting auf der Arbeit. Was aus purer Langeweile als winziges Text-Abenteuer in einem CMD-Fenster begann, ist nach einiger Zeit zu dem Wahnsinn geworden, den du hier siehst. Ich entwickle dieses Spiel komplett als Solo-Entwickler in meiner Freizeit – angetrieben von viel Herzblut. Mit dem Kauf unterstützt du direkt die weitere Entwicklung und zukünftige Updates.

store_data.about_the_game:
You thought going to the supermarket was easy? Yeah… no.

Welcome to Blurry Shopping, a game about getting hopelessly lost between endless aisles, buzzing fluorescent lights, and products that all look exactly the same (because for you, they do).

You’re a broke guy with absurdly bad eyesight. No glasses. No contacts. Not even a helpful optician nearby.

Your goal is simple: find the exit.

What stands in your way? Blurry vision, confusing layouts, and a supermarket that seems to actively dislike you.

· 20 levels, each more ridiculous than the previous one

· Aisles that seems to be engineered by a caveman

· Shopping carts that refuse to behave

· Situations so dumb they somehow make sense (yes, jumping ramps inside a supermarket makes sense)

This isn’t just about leaving, it’s about enduring the most cursed supermarket ever designed. Slam carts at full speed, avoid lethal special offers, and find out what really waits at the end of the frozen aisle.

It looks like a quick shopping trip, but you’ll end up stressed, confused, and questioning your life choices.

Only a few will find the exit.

The rest will give up somewhere near the snacks.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shroomanoid is an action roguelite inspired by classic games like Arkanoid and Breakout, where your character acts like a ball of fury.

  • Fight enemies and powerful bosses

  • Forge armor sets to get stronger

  • Upgrade your skills

  • Turn enemies into fertilizer and build your mushroom forest base

Features:

  • Shroomanoid never stops; it dashes, bounces, and deals damage to everything around it.

  • Unique control system: the character moves on its own like a ball of fury, and you influence its path through abilities and platform hits.

  • A variety of enemies: they differ not just in HP and damage, but each has its own unique traits.

  • A variety of armor sets, each granting a unique ability, along with the option to craft especially powerful sets.

  • Many different relics, some of which significantly change the gameplay.

  • Weather affects gameplay: Rain extinguishes burning enemies, snow makes them slide and easier to knock off, strong winds can blow the character away, and thunderstorms may strike with sudden lightning.

  • Power-ups are diverse, affecting gameplay differently when collected by the character or the platform.

  • Deep meta-progression with base-building. The key feature: you can’t just max out everything and become overpowered. Bonuses need to be activated, and you can’t activate them all at once. The bonus system isn’t just about power-ups — it’s about choosing a gameplay style, since boosting some stats weakens others. As a result, the game always stays challenging, but remains beatable even without meta-progression.

  • An event system where your choices don’t guarantee a specific outcome. Each choice can lead to multiple possibilities, preventing you from simply memorizing all events and always picking the same options — instead, you must decide based on the situation.

  • Every run is unique. Levels are procedurally generated, and a variety of relics, armor sets and bonuses alter the gameplay, making each new playthrough different from the previous one.

  • If the game feels too easy, you can challenge yourself with ascensions and additional challenges

Features:

  • Shroomanoid never stops; it dashes, bounces, and deals damage to everything around it.

  • Unique control system: the character moves on its own like a ball of fury, and you influence its path through abilities and platform hits.

  • A variety of enemies: they differ not just in HP and damage, but each has its own unique traits.

  • A variety of armor sets, each granting a unique ability, along with the option to craft especially powerful sets.

  • Many different relics, some of which significantly change the gameplay.

  • Weather affects gameplay: Rain extinguishes burning enemies, snow makes them slide and easier to knock off, strong winds can blow the character away, and thunderstorms may strike with sudden lightning.

  • Power-ups are diverse, affecting gameplay differently when collected by the character or the platform.

  • Deep meta-progression with base-building. The key feature: you can’t just max out everything and become overpowered. Bonuses need to be activated, and you can’t activate them all at once. The bonus system isn’t just about power-ups — it’s about choosing a gameplay style, since boosting some stats weakens others. As a result, the game always stays challenging, but remains beatable even without meta-progression.

  • An event system where your choices don’t guarantee a specific outcome. Each choice can lead to multiple possibilities, preventing you from simply memorizing all events and always picking the same options — instead, you must decide based on the situation.

  • Every run is unique. Levels are procedurally generated, and a variety of relics, armor sets and bonuses alter the gameplay, making each new playthrough different from the previous one.

  • If the game feels too easy, you can challenge yourself with ascensions and additional challenges
store_data.short_description: Shroomanoid is an action roguelite inspired by classic games like Arkanoid and Breakout, where your character acts like a ball of fury. Fight enemies and powerful bosses, forge armor sets, upgrade your skills, and spread spores throughout the forest.

store_data.about_the_game:
This prologue contains the first 2 cases of Unattached: City of Shadows, as well as some side activities to showcase its world. The description of the main game is as follows:

Welcome to New Eastbrook

In this city, no closet is without skeletons. You are James Arnold, a rookie detective assigned to investigate the assassination of New Eastbrook's mayor, Casey Ward, as well as the seemingly-connected deaths of police officers throughout the year of 2022. Every lead drags you deeper into a web of mob power, crooked cops, and corruption that will not yield. Savour a fully-voiced tumultuous detective story involving constant emotional, rarely clear-cut decisions.

  • Search crime scenes for hidden evidence, from bloody weapons left behind to mobile phones of victims containing suspicious phone records.

  • Piece together the evidence obtained to build an idea of what happened in each crime scene, the motives behind the crime, and who committed it.

  • Interrogate suspects using a mix of sympathy, stone-cold neutrality, and raw aggression as needed to draw out the truth.

  • No choice is ever clean; the paths you take in each case will reveal what type of detective you choose to be.

  • Bend and sometimes even break the law, lockpick your way into locked locations to uncover hidden evidence

  • Hijack vehicles to chase leads or reach crime scenes faster

  • Make hard choices when the law stands in the way of the truth, sometimes needing to spill blood to get closer to cleaning up the city.

  • Engage in a gritty, melee-only souls-like combat using a vast array of weapons, from baseball bats to meat cleavers.

  • Fight alone against the worst of the city, from thugs in a back alley to mob enforcers in a warehouse.

  • Use a combination of timing, positioning, and bravery to defeat enemies in encounters where the odds are never in your favour. Greed is punished, timing is rewarded.

  • Customize your character, visit the various barbers and clothing shops to change your look.

  • Buy houses across the city and customize their interior furniture to your liking.

  • Tune your ride: paint jobs, seat colours, interiors, and tires; as well as a spoiler and a supercharger (which also tunes your car's engine).

  • Invest in businesses that return a steady income to keep the lifestyle going.

  • Delve into a large open world where you can also visit restaurants to refuel and pawn shops to sell whatever junk you collect along the way of your adventures.

  • Participate in side activities such as backyard brawls.

store_data.about_the_game:
Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports.

You play as Emma, an overworked accountant who feels like her life is in the deep end. That’s when Hal, the IT guy stomps down the door. What starts as basic tech support evolves into shared hobbies, family dinners, and conversations that were never in the job description.

The game focuses on:

  • Realistic adult romance in a corporate setting.

  • The struggle of balancing burnout with a new relationship.

  • Family pressure and cultural boundaries.

  • The specific intimacy found in daily text messages.

Features:

  • 100,000 words of story content.

  • Multiple routes with distinct romantic tones.

  • The "First Meeting" prequel chapter.

  • DnD segments that reveal the characters' inner messes.

  • An expanded cast including Becca from Marketing and Hal’s mom.

  • Numerous CGs capturing comedic and romantic milestones.

Low Effort Romance is for players who enjoy character-driven stories, slow-burn tension, and the unique horror of realizing your entire office knew you had a crush before you did.

Characters:

Emma, an exhausted corporate accountant. After her last boyfriend dumped her via a single text message sent from a beach in Bali, she officially retired from real-world dating. Her heart now belongs to Leon from Love and Fantasia, a 2D yandere with a tragic backstory and will never ghost her for a surfing trip.

She thinks that’s the end, then IT shows up.

Hal is the "temp" tech guy who looks like he hasn't slept since the cloud was invented. He is the opposite of smooth, and more like the kind of person who says something sweet accidentally then immediately looks for a server rack to hide behind. Somehow, he managed to fix Emma’s actual and metaphorical hardware.

Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

store_data.about_the_game:
Embale is a physics-based, first-person downhill racing game about speed, control, and chaos on steep, narrow city streets in Quito, Ecuador. Your cart is wood, your steering is raw, and the road gives you no space to breathe. You are not driving a car. You’re hanging on and making micro-decisions every second.

Pick your line, manage your momentum, and use the street like a weapon. Clip a corner too hard and you lose the run. Play it safe and someone slips past on the inside. Every descent is a fast problem to solve, with physics that rewards precision and punishes panic.

Built for PC and consoles, with controls designed for quick restarts and “one more run” progression.

Key Features

  • First-person racing for maximum speed and threat perception

  • Physics-based handling: momentum, grip, impacts, and recovery matter

  • Tight downhill routes inspired by Quito’s steep streets

  • Aggressive line choice: overtake in inches, or pay the price

  • Readable chaos: mistakes are your fault, and also your opportunity

  • Designed for PC and consoles, controller-friendly from day one

Feel the hill

Downhill racing is not about top speed. It’s about keeping the cart stable while the street tries to throw you out of it.

Choose your risk

Wide line for safety, tight line for time. Passing is a commitment.

Survive contact

Bumps, scrapes, and near-misses are part of the run. The best racers recover instantly.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Light is a Story campaign-based sandbox game where you play as the Shell, a mysterious being on a mission to rescue their beloved—imprisoned inside the sun. To break the chains that bind them, you must defeat the ancient guardians keeping the solar prison intact.

Explore. Fight. Break the cycle.

Free the One Inside the Sun

You are The Shell, a lone being searching for the one imprisoned inside the sun.

Ancient guardians hold the solar prison together.
To reach the heart of it, you must defeat them.

But every guardian you destroy reshapes the world that depends on them.

A World Built on Guardians

Guardians are not just enemies.
They are foundations of the world itself.

When one falls:

• Regions begin to transform
• Environmental forces weaken or shift
• Familiar paths may disappear
• New routes may emerge

Power always comes with consequences.

Choose When to Act

There is no fixed order.

Choose which guardian to confront and when.

Defeating one early may grant powerful relics —
but it may also change the balance of the world in ways that alter your entire journey.

Every campaign can unfold differently based on your decisions.

Exploration as Understanding

Traverse interconnected biomes shaped by the presence of guardians.

• Discover hidden routes
• Return to transformed regions
• Adapt to shifting terrain
• Decide what to preserve — and what to sacrifice

The land evolves with your choices.

Gameplay Features

• Single-player campaign experience
• Non-linear guardian encounters
• World-altering progression system
• Ability-based exploration
• Atmospheric environments and original soundtrack

Development Status

A Light is currently in early development.

Core guardian mechanics, world interaction systems, and visual direction are actively being refined.

A Kickstarter campaign is planned to support expanded production quality, including animation polish, sound design, and additional content.

Follow the Journey

Wishlist A Light to stay updated and be notified when the journey begins.

store_data.about_the_game:
A-MAZE-ING Tower Defense

Return to the classics with a dark fantasy twist. Build twisting mazes, bait enemy paths, and stack absurd artifact synergies as you push your defenses further each run. Play solo or jump into online co-op with up to 4 players and turn your maze into a deathtrap together.

Classic Tower Defense Feel, Modern Roguelite Energy

If you miss the era when tower defense was simple, readable, and brutally satisfying. This is that vibe, upgraded. Thoughtful choices, unique runs, and a loop that keeps pulling you back in!

Build the Maze. Break the Horde.

In Dark Fantasy Tower Defense, your layout is your weapon. Shape the battlefield into a labyrinth that forces enemies to take the long way around... right through the kill zone. Every tower placement, choke point, and corner matters.

Tower Upgrades + Pick-a-Path Evolutions

Your towers get stronger, faster, and can shoot further with upgrades! Each run, upgrade your favorite towers and choose between two distinct upgrade paths to match your build:

  • Wizard Tower: unleash explosive cluster bombs, or focus into a devastating laser beam!

  • Lightning Tower: jump damage with chain lightning and shred groups or blast the skies!

  • Ice Tower: freeze the earth with powerful slows… or launch a giant snowball to smash the front line!

  • Arrow Tower: Triple shot or poison your enemies!

  • Lookout Tower: Deal double damage or splash damage on enemies in a large group!

And it’s not just damage dealers... build Support Towers to supercharge your defense:

  • Archer Camp: boost the range of nearby towers

  • Barracks: increase the damage of nearby towers

Artifacts & Merchant (Make Every Run Different)

Each run is shaped by what you buy, what you find, and how you stack effects with your team. Every 50 waves, visit the Merchant where you can purchase up to 3 of the 20+ items that can alter the run from economy and utility boosts to power spikes that change how your maze plays.

On top of that, your hero can collect 25+ player artifacts with game-changing effects. Unlock an artifact chest every 20 waves to Mix, match, and stack synergies (especially in co-op) to create wild builds that push towers, enemies, and the rules of the run in your favor.

  • 20+ Merchant items to customize your strategy mid-run

  • 25+ player artifacts with unique, run-defining effects

  • Stack effects in co-op for absurd synergy and team builds

  • Every run plays differently thanks to randomized pick-3 options for Merchant and Artifacts to build variety

  • Level-Up to get Artifact Keys to unlock new artifacts and reveal new items for purchase at the Merchant!

Online Co-op (Up to 4 Players)

Build as a team, adapt as a team, and survive as a team online as a group of up to 4 friends. Coordinate maze layouts, cover weaknesses, and lean into synergy because the best defenses are the ones your friends helped ruin (in the best way). Local Co-op up to 2 Players! NOTE: Local co-op will require a controller for player 2.

Full Controller Support

Play comfortably from the couch or at your desk! Dark Fantasy Tower Defense is fully playable on controller with smooth menu navigation and responsive in-game controls. Local co-op players can each use their own controller, making split-screen sessions easy to set up and feel great to play.

Ten Maps Available (More Coming Soon!)

Start your runs across 10 distinct maps, each with its own layout quirks, obstacles, and challenges that change how you build your maze and choose your upgrades:

  • Boulder Canyon

  • Magma Plains

  • Flame Sprite Grove

  • Crimson Rampart

  • Fighting Pit

  • and more!!!

And this is only the beginning... more maps are planned, bringing new hazards, pathing puzzles, and fresh ways to break the horde.

Enemy Highlights

  • Orc warbands with Boars, Orc Riders, and Orc Rider Captains. Take down the mount first, then finish the rider

  • Haunted Trees and Ghosts that turn the battlefield into a nightmare

  • Flying threats like the Thorax that punish weak anti-air coverage

  • Kobolds that swarm and slip through bad layouts

  • Stone Golems, Ogres, and Minotaur that soak damage and break through sloppy choke points

  • Mimics because treasure is treasure

  • Mini-bosses like the Battle Wagon and Zeppelin. When they go down, they drop orcs into the fight

  • A Final Test: A flying Dragon boss that demands a real build, not a lucky run

Features:

  • Maze-building gameplay that turns pathing into your primary strategy

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players

  • Local Co-op for up to 2 players (controller required for at least 1 player)

  • Roguelite structure with run-to-run variety and escalating difficulty

  • Artifacts + synergy system for wild build combinations

  • Merchant + Items for changing the game for yourself or others... at a cost!

  • Tower upgrades with pick-2 branching paths for different playstyles

  • Support Towers that buff nearby defenses with Range or Damage

  • Diverse enemy roster with special behaviors, flying units, swarms, tanky brutes, mini-bosses that spawn enemies on death, and a Dragon boss showdown

  • Dark fantasy atmosphere with a retro-styled presentation

  • Easy to learn, hard to master: layout, timing, and synergy win runs
