Tower Upgrades + Pick-a-Path Evolutions

Your towers get stronger, faster, and can shoot further with upgrades! Each run, upgrade your favorite towers and choose between two distinct upgrade paths to match your build:

  • Wizard Tower: unleash explosive cluster bombs, or focus into a devastating laser beam!

  • Lightning Tower: jump damage with chain lightning and shred groups or blast the skies!

  • Ice Tower: freeze the earth with powerful slows… or launch a giant snowball to smash the front line!

  • Arrow Tower: Triple shot or poison your enemies!

  • Lookout Tower: Deal double damage or splash damage on enemies in a large group!

And it’s not just damage dealers... build Support Towers to supercharge your defense:

  • Archer Camp: boost the range of nearby towers

  • Barracks: increase the damage of nearby towers

Artifacts & Merchant (Make Every Run Different)

Each run is shaped by what you buy, what you find, and how you stack effects with your team. Every 50 waves, visit the Merchant where you can purchase up to 3 of the 20+ items that can alter the run from economy and utility boosts to power spikes that change how your maze plays.

On top of that, your hero can collect 25+ player artifacts with game-changing effects. Unlock an artifact chest every 20 waves to Mix, match, and stack synergies (especially in co-op) to create wild builds that push towers, enemies, and the rules of the run in your favor.

  • 20+ Merchant items to customize your strategy mid-run

  • 25+ player artifacts with unique, run-defining effects

  • Stack effects in co-op for absurd synergy and team builds

  • Every run plays differently thanks to randomized pick-3 options for Merchant and Artifacts to build variety

  • Level-Up to get Artifact Keys to unlock new artifacts and reveal new items for purchase at the Merchant!

Online Co-op (Up to 4 Players)

Build as a team, adapt as a team, and survive as a team online as a group of up to 4 friends. Coordinate maze layouts, cover weaknesses, and lean into synergy because the best defenses are the ones your friends helped ruin (in the best way). Local Co-op up to 2 Players! NOTE: Local co-op will require a controller for player 2.

Full Controller Support

Play comfortably from the couch or at your desk! Dark Fantasy Tower Defense is fully playable on controller with smooth menu navigation and responsive in-game controls. Local co-op players can each use their own controller, making split-screen sessions easy to set up and feel great to play.

Ten Maps Available (More Coming Soon!)

Start your runs across 10 distinct maps, each with its own layout quirks, obstacles, and challenges that change how you build your maze and choose your upgrades:

  • Boulder Canyon

  • Magma Plains

  • Flame Sprite Grove

  • Crimson Rampart

  • Fighting Pit

  • and more!!!

And this is only the beginning... more maps are planned, bringing new hazards, pathing puzzles, and fresh ways to break the horde.

Enemy Highlights

  • Orc warbands with Boars, Orc Riders, and Orc Rider Captains. Take down the mount first, then finish the rider

  • Haunted Trees and Ghosts that turn the battlefield into a nightmare

  • Flying threats like the Thorax that punish weak anti-air coverage

  • Kobolds that swarm and slip through bad layouts

  • Stone Golems, Ogres, and Minotaur that soak damage and break through sloppy choke points

  • Mimics because treasure is treasure

  • Mini-bosses like the Battle Wagon and Zeppelin. When they go down, they drop orcs into the fight

  • A Final Test: A flying Dragon boss that demands a real build, not a lucky run

Features:

  • Maze-building gameplay that turns pathing into your primary strategy

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players

  • Local Co-op for up to 2 players (controller required for at least 1 player)

  • Roguelite structure with run-to-run variety and escalating difficulty

  • Artifacts + synergy system for wild build combinations

  • Merchant + Items for changing the game for yourself or others... at a cost!

  • Tower upgrades with pick-2 branching paths for different playstyles

  • Support Towers that buff nearby defenses with Range or Damage

  • Diverse enemy roster with special behaviors, flying units, swarms, tanky brutes, mini-bosses that spawn enemies on death, and a Dragon boss showdown

  • Dark fantasy atmosphere with a retro-styled presentation

  • Easy to learn, hard to master: layout, timing, and synergy win runs

store_data.about_the_game:
It's 1990. You have an idea, a business card, and the vague sense that this "internet" thing might be worth something.

You're probably right... you're also probably doomed.

Build. Burn. Repeat.


Vested is a narrative strategy game about founding a tech startup and trying (really trying) to survive the dot-com bubble. Make quarterly decisions that ripple across your company's finances, culture, board dynamics, and your own sanity. Every choice has consequences. Some of them take years to arrive.

Choose your product. Choose your funding. Then watch as the market, your employees, your board, and your own ambition conspire to determine which of 19 distinct endings you stumble into.

Most of them aren't pretty.

The Interface Is the Timeline


The game's interface evolves as the internet does. You'll know what year it is before you read a single word.

Features


  • 48 quarters of decisions from Q1 1990 to Q4 2001
  • 19 endings: Will you become a billionaire with a successful IPO... or will you just burn out?
  • Every playthrough different, every decision grounded in real dot-com history
  • 6 industries, 18 products, and 3 funding paths that fundamentally change your journey
  • A stat system where the numbers you don't know matter more than the ones you do
  • Post-mortem analysis that shows you exactly how close you came
  • 30-45 minute playthroughs: quick enough for "one more run", deep enough to reward strategy
  • Seed codes: share your exact starting scenario and challenge friends to beat your ending

Steam Extras


  • 33 achievements hidden across endings, milestones, and places you weren't looking
  • Cloud saves across devices
  • Your Steam status shows your startup's valuation. Your friends can watch you rise... or crash.

A Game About Timing


History says the crash was inevitable. Hindsight says the signs were obvious. But in the moment? In the moment, everyone thought they were the exception.

Try not to prove them right.

Vested is also available as a free web version at . The Steam edition adds achievements, cloud saves, and the smug satisfaction of supporting an indie game.

store_data.about_the_game:
They are having a terrible day. You are going to watch.

Based on a popular YouTube video titled "Yelling At Cats," Yelling At Cats: The Game is a tense, room-scale stealth game told entirely from the low-to-the-ground perspective of a house cat. Your Owner is stomping around the house, muttering to themselves after a long series of highly relatable, incredibly petty inconveniences. Your goal? Secretly observe them until the timer runs out.

Key Features:

  • True Feline Stealth: Navigate a suburban house from a cat's perspective. Use couches, tables, and doorways to break line of sight the moment the Owner's gaze swings your way.

  • Immersive 3D Audio: Featuring physically accurate sound propagation. Listen to the Owner's iconic voice lines vibrate through the floorboards, behind closed doors and wrap around corners. Your ears are your greatest weapon.

  • Tense Observation: You have to look at them to make progress, but if they see you, you only have a split-second grace period to scramble back into the shadows before your progress is wiped clean.

  • Dynamic Scares & Laughs: Survive the tension of being stalked, only to be rewarded with randomly generated, hilarious reasons for why your Owner was so mad in the first place!

store_data.about_the_game:
Russia, 2005.

A romanticized view of street life mixed with petty crime still lingers in the courtyards. Prepaid dial-up internet is making its way into homes. At school, just like in the real world, everything is perfectly simple: there are the strong, the quiet, and everyone knows their place.

The Illusion of Safety

You are an ordinary guy from a provincial town in Tatarstan. Neither a leader nor a rebel. You are used to staying on the sidelines and keeping out of other people's conflicts. Your goal is to quietly finish school so that no one bothers you.

But sometimes, it all starts with a minor detail. With a third sleepless night and a heavy, unfamiliar stare in the school hallway.

Point of No Return

At some point, your usual tactics stop working. A single day breaks the order you are used to. Insomnia intensifies everything around you: irritation grows, mistakes pile up, and reality begins to distort. Every decision carries consequences.

Can you remain yourself when forced to prove your strength? And what happens when the fear suddenly fades? This is a story about pressure and choices. About a day after which you can no longer pretend to be just an observer.

Game Features:

  • Non-linear narrative with choices that lead the story into unexpected directions.

  • Psychological tension and the gradual, inevitable escalation of conflict.

  • Thick atmosphere of a harsh school environment and teenage showdowns of the 2000s.

  • Descent into madness: the deep internal monologue of a protagonist whose mind is exhausted by insomnia.

  • Multiple interpretations of events — you will have to decide for yourself what is actually real.

⚠️ Content Warning:

This game contains scenes of violence, aggressive behavior, and strong language.

store_data.about_the_game:
A cozy incremental game about collecting honey from flowers, building honeycomb, and hatching bees to collect even more honey.

Collect Honey From Flowers

Click on a flower to send your bee to gather from that flower. Hovering over a flower will tell you about that flower and how much honey it provides for one payload. 

Bees will find more flowers in the garden as your hive grows in size and from experience over time.

BEWARE!

Flowers disappear in the winter, so store honey in cells as needed. Your swarm of bees consume honey daily! 

Grow Your Hive

As you collect honey from flowers, you are able to build more honeycomb cells. When you have collected enough honey, you can click on a cell, highlighted in green, that you want to build. Hovering over a cell slot will show the amount of honey needed to construct another honeycomb cell. 

Once you have an open cell in your honeycomb, you can then spend more honey on hatching new bees to collect more honey. More experienced and efficient bees can be hatched, once you've purchased enough bees of the previous level. 

Queen Ascension

Queen bees only live for a certain number of days before they leave. Once your queen is ready to ascend you'll be given the choice to select a new Queen Bee to start a new swarm all over again. Luckily, you get to keep the hive and inherit all the honey!

Is that AI or Photoshop?

Yes. It's photoshopped. Long before men faked lunar landings, bees have been landing on flowers. Hive Thrive uses actual photos of real bees and real flowers!

Sadly, the Bee's Knees Gym does not accept human members.

store_data.about_the_game:
Heave-Ho: Uphill Has Never Been This Infuriating (and Hilarious)!

Gather your squad, grab the ride, and start pushing! Your goal is simple: reach the peak. But beware—unforgiving physics, brutal obstacles, and one tiny mistake from a teammate can send hours of hard work crashing down to the bottom.

Teamwork or Utter Chaos

This isn't just a casual stroll; it's the ultimate test of patience and communication. As you navigate narrow cliffs, wobbly platforms, and absurd traps, there’s only one rule: Move together or fall together! If one of you jumps at the wrong time or pushes the vehicle in the wrong direction, you’re all going back to square one. Get ready to put your friendships to the test.

Key Features:

  • Physics-Based Agony: Every bump, ramp, and platform reacts entirely to physics. Pushing the vehicle is easy; keeping it under control is practically impossible!

  • 1-4 Player Online Co-Op: Try to summit solo and become a legend, or bring up to 3 friends to multiply the chaos by four.

  • Fall Freely, No Giving Up: There are no checkpoints here. When you fall, you have to get back up and keep pushing. It's just you, your crew, and the peak.

  • Addictive Difficulty: That familiar, punishing platformer experience that will have you screaming "just one more try" until the sun comes up. The ultimate mix of rage and satisfaction.

What awaits you at the top? There's only one way to find out. Start pushing!

store_data.about_the_game:
VOID ANOMALY is an upcoming 1–4 player, mission-based space horror game currently in early development.

In this teaser, you won’t see gameplay mechanics yet — the project is still in its early stages, and core systems are actively being developed. This video focuses purely on atmosphere and tone.

Set in the depths of space, Void Anomaly will feature both cooperative and solo missions, allowing players to face its challenges alone or together with up to three others.

The experience aims to combine:

• Tension and unpredictability

• Mysterious, unsettling environments

• Mission-driven gameplay for 1–4 players

• Chaotic and intense moments that are especially memorable with friends

The goal is to create a space horror experience that feels immersive, mysterious, and intense — while still being genuinely fun to play, whether alone or in co-op.

Development is ongoing.

Wishlist on Steam to follow the journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
A Colonial Noir Mystery

The Red Pearls of Borneo is an atmospheric deduction game inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn, The Case of the Golden Idol and Type Help. You are a clairvoyant investigator in 1948 London, exploring the psychic echoes of a tragedy that occurred seven years prior on a remote plantation in Borneo.

Your tools are simple: a box of old photographs, a map of the plantation and your unique ability to step into the past.

London, 1948

Jeremiah Goodwill's tobacco plantation was supposed to be a paradise. But on the night of December 16th, 1941, as the Japanese Imperial Navy loomed on the horizon, the estate fell into chaos.

Sort through the lies. Reveal the faces of the strangers. Discover what truly happened in the Goodwill plantation that fateful night.

Key Features:

  • Echoes of the Past: Explore a non-linear timeline. Jump between witness perspectives and moments in time to uncover motives, secret meetings and fatal mistakes.

  • The "Mind's Eye": Use a unique node-based deduction system to visualise the movement of guests across the island. Connect the dots to prove who was where, and when.

  • Make notes of everything everywhere: You can keep notes on all aspects of the game. From characters and locations to items and snippets of text from clues.

  • Learn about the rarely told history of Borneo on the eve of WW2 through the interactive glossary you will unlock as you go.

Can you piece together the truth before the memories fade? Identify the guests, determine their fates and solve the mystery of the Red Pearls!

store_data.about_the_game:
Discover Prehistoric Fossils

Travel to excavation sites and carefully brush away layers of earth to uncover prehistoric skeletons hidden beneath the surface.

Each dig is a puzzle of patience and curiosity. As dirt tiles are cleared away, fossilized bones slowly emerge from the ground until the full skeleton is revealed.

Every discovery brings you closer to building a world-class collection of prehistoric life.

Excavate Ancient Dinosaurs

Use careful excavation techniques to uncover fossils buried for millions of years.

As you remove dirt and rock piece by piece, entire dinosaur skeletons gradually appear beneath the soil.

Discover famous prehistoric species including:

  • Tyrannosaurus rex

  • Triceratops

  • Edmontosaurus

Each fossil includes scientific information that helps bring the ancient world back to life.

Build Your Own Fossil Museum

Return your discoveries to your museum and create exhibits showcasing the creatures you uncover.

Arrange fossils, build displays, and expand your museum as your collection grows.

Your museum becomes a record of every dig, every discovery, and every species you uncover.

Relaxing Exploration

Fossil Bound is designed to be calm, rewarding, and curiosity-driven.

There are no enemies, no time pressure, and no combat.

The focus is on exploration, discovery, and the satisfaction of uncovering prehistoric life.

Key Features

• Carefully excavate fossils tile by tile
• Discover famous dinosaur species
• Reveal full skeletons hidden beneath the ground
• Build and grow your own fossil museum
• Learn fascinating facts about prehistoric life
• Relaxing gameplay focused on discovery

store_data.about_the_game:
A Gothic Tale of Love, Obsession and Mystery

In the shadowed halls of a crumbling 19th-century Styrian castle, innocent and lonely Laura finds her life irrevocably changed by a mysterious guest called Carmilla.

Who is this divine beauty that has suddenly come into her life? Why is her Governess Madam Perrodon so suspicious of the new arrival? Will Laura's father Lord Astor offer her counsel? Or is he also ensnared in the delicate web?

And then there are the deaths of women in the nearby village. They died wasting away because of strange illness. Could these deaths be connected to the castle?

As the boundaries between love, loyalty and corruption blur, Laura must choose her path.

Will she surrender to her desires or will she resist corruption?

Gameplay & Key Features

  • Branching Narrative: You play Laura, the innocent young lady of the castle. Your interactions with Carmilla and the inhabitants of the castle dictate the flow of the story, leading to divergent paths and unique character interactions.

  • Multiple Endings: Discover 4 distinct endings, ranging from a tragic spiral into madness to a dark, eternal union. Your moral compass determines Laura's ultimate fate and that of others.

  • The Corruption and Loyalty System: Manage Laura’s internal struggle. Laura's choices will impact corruption and loyalty meters which will sculpt the story and also unlock specific story beats and hidden dialogue.

  • Stunning Gothic Aesthetic: Experience the macabre beauty of a Gothic Castle through hand-painted character sprites and lush, atmospheric backgrounds inspired by classic 19th-century horror.

  • Atmospheric Soundscape: A haunting score which uses classical piano renditions with atmospheric pads will heighten the tension in the story.

The Choice is Yours

Will you uncover the truth behind the sudden deaths haunting the village? Will you act on it? Or will you simply let yourself be consumed?

In this dark yuri reimagining of the classic novella, your innermost desires will shape your path.

Most of the cards will hurt you - one way or the other. Juggle your way through the run by winning enemies before your cards kill you><

Each encounter gives you at least one card in your deck. Your starter hand is chosen at the start of the run^^

The Cat that fears pain the most has to battle using cards that hurt her before the enemies. It's the only way for her, and she pushes even tho each step scares her to death..

RUN through the woods, mines, and literal HELL to bring her family back!

Roguelike

Between biomes, you can send cards home to equip them at the start of the next Run!

Also, there are talismans that you can equip that give you synergies between cards or just give passive bonuses - The Devil doesn't burn them seing them as nothing special

store_data.about_the_game:
It starts with a TV advertisement, caught by our eye.

They tell that it’s a CHALLENGE!

Now we have the chances to show others that we are competent to outwit the game.

We want to be there, we want to be entertained, we like to solve mysteries, we love to feel the adrenaline, racing with the time, aren’t we?

But once you solve the first puzzle in the lobby and step into that dark corridor, you'll realize this place is much more than a game. The rules are simple: Solve or die.

To wake up from this claustrophobic nightmare, you'll need to use your wits and reflexes at the same time. Every room holds a new puzzle, and every corridor hides a new threat.

Mind-Bending, Deadly Puzzles: Examine your surroundings carefully to survive. Crack codes, trigger hidden mechanisms, and piece together the right clues to unlock the next room. Time is not on your side.

Terrifying Encounters: You are not alone. Every puzzle you solve brings you one step closer to the exit, but it also draws their attention. Can you fight the beings after you? Your only chance is to solve puzzles and survive.

Claustrophobic & Atmospheric Environments: Narrowing corridors, eerie soundscapes, and the fear of the unknown waiting around every corner. With a creepy and a dark atmosphere, you'll feel the tension breathing down your neck at every moment.

You fell for the ad and walked right in. But will you be able to walk out?

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up in a velvet-draped casino that seems suspended in a void, run by faceless dealers and watched by an unseen Host. You're told you owe a "debt of existence" and must earn your right to live another day by beating the Quota — a cash target that rises with each round. You have 5 rounds to meet or exceed the quota, or… you're out. Permanently.

💵 Core Gameplay:

  • You start with $50.

  • You must reach a quota of $150 in 5 rounds. The quota increases after each successful completion.

  • Each round, you are matched with an NPC to play "21", a dark variant of Blackjack.

♠️ Trump Cards:

Every player gets access to Trump Cards — single-use twists that bend or break the rules of 21. Trump Cards can be bought, earned through riskier plays, or awarded after surviving intense matches.

🕒 The Clock Is Ticking:

Each round has a real-time limit, forcing you to make decisions under pressure. As the game progresses:

  • The time shortens.

  • Opponents grow more unpredictable or monstrous.

  • Visuals distort — cards bleed, tables stretch, opponents twitch unnaturally.

Fail to meet the quota in time? You’re pulled into “The Pit”, a final death-match round where the odds are heavily stacked, but survival might buy you another cycle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Congratulations. You've been chosen. 

The job is simple. Carry the designated cargo to the designated location. That's all. 

You don't need to ask where it came from. You don't need to check what's inside. 

That's──not your job…

A dark cargo-delivery adventure through the slums, as a state-licensed carrier.

Load it. Haul it. Sell it. — 

Your vehicle has limited cargo space. 

Calculate the size of every package and load with maximum efficiency. The higher the payout, the more irregular the shape—and the more it fights you. Today's income depends on that judgment. If you put the reward you earn into living expenses and upgrading your vehicle, you'll be able to take on more jobs.

Sector:06 — A slum district stretching along the outer rim of the city-state Centralva. 

The glow of the central skyscrapers doesn't reach here. 

A place where what is "unneeded" ends up. The residents, the streets, even the massive waste-processing grounds. And the nameless things. As you keep taking jobs, you begin to see this city more clearly… —whether you want to or not.

Never check the "cargo" — unless you wish to lose your sanity. 

Unknown cargo sells for a high price. But to confirm the price, you have to look inside. Whether you loosen the mouth of the burlap sack is your decision. But once you've seen it——you can't go back.

Your choices decide the ending. 

Sometimes, the requests include something… strange. A name not listed on the state-issued order. A client who won't answer questions. If you think rationally, the correct move is to keep obeying. And yet—you might choose not to. Whether that was the right answer is something you can realize later.

Game Features

  • Inventory management: a loading puzzle built on three factors—size, weight, and stability. What you load and what you leave behind determines your profit.

  • Profit vs. price you pay: high-value, unknown cargo erodes your driving, your judgment, your sanity—little by little—each time you check what's inside.

  • Story progresses through jobs: the state, the residents, and unknown clients. A stack of deliveries slowly reveals the outline of the world.

  • Unease beneath the cute fur: an art style where lovable animal characters coexist with unsettling waste.

  • Multiple endings: keep obeying, or choose to have a will of your own. In the latter half, your "rational" choices begin to take on a different meaning.

store_data.about_the_game:
The World Sleeps

When you begin, the world is completely black and white and there is no music whatsoever. Everything except for you is frozen in time. As soon as you find your first musical instrument you can play it to bring a small pocket of the world back to life. Use your instrument to make platforms move, enemies move, and open up new traversal options.

Discover New Songs

Solve puzzles to make the music stronger. When you begin your music is quiet  and simple, as you solve more puzzles the world starts to play and dance along with the music and add more of its own layers to the songs. Completing areas allows you to hear all that the songs have to offer and unlock exclusive secrets that the music unlocks.

Uncover Secrets

Why is the world asleep and why did the music stop? Why are you the one to try to bring it back? Find exclusive items and secrets to uncover the true power of music to heal and uncover hidden meanings

Features

  • About 2 hours of playtime

  • 3 instruments to discover

  • 40+ platforming puzzle rooms

  • 6 audio tracks to build

  • No bananas to be found

store_data.about_the_game:
Become Atlas, a nomadic shepherd who lost their sheep in the midst of the White Water Wars. Losing their purpose, they drift into a series of recurring nightmares, while in search of refuge from the darkness around them. 

Akin to a classical play, unravel the world of Atlas’ dreamscapes through FOUR acts. Reconcile with a mysterious four-headed beast, by bringing them lost artifacts hidden in a carnivorous plant infested meadow, unforgiving icy mountains, a ghost town fortress, and the surreal outer space.

Team up with Aries, an optimistic little blue sheep. Guide her to find juicy grass patches that multiply your sheep. Watch out for corrupted creatures and protect your flock using your shepherd’s sling. 

Forage paint droplets from the grass patches and restore the broken passageways in your dreamscapes. Or– as Aries likes to call it, “repainting” what was broken by the war.

Converse with unexpected allies who help Atlas’ recollect how the war came to be.

store_data.about_the_game:
Length is your life. Every hit costs you tail. Stay longer than your opponent, grind them down to nothing, and rack up +3 points per takedown.

CLEAR THE COUCH.

Up to 8 players on one shared screen. No accounts, no setup, no waiting. Plug in up to 8 controllers, split the keyboard four ways (WASD, IJKL, Arrows, Numpad), or cram two players onto a single gamepad. Mix and match. Nobody sits out. Everyone joins by pressing UP.

Take on the story campaign solo or in 2-player co-op. Or bring the chaos to four battle modes: Score Battle, Timed Match, Snake Royale, Endless Classic. Tune speed, scale CPU difficulty, run teams or free-for-all, crank food spawns to Foodpocalypse, slap a custom nameplate on every snake. Your house, your rules.

20 SERPENTS. EACH ONE PLAYS DIFFERENT.

Speed, acceleration, starting length, growth rate. Every snake feels distinct. Tanks wall off whole sections of the board. Speed Demons close gaps before you've finished planning. Growers start tiny and snowball into terrors. Half the roster is yours from day one. The rest are bosses you'll meet, fight, and recruit.

THE WAR BEHIND THE WAR

An ancient war between serpents. A living darkness feeding on the conflict. The Order seeks unity. The Fangs choose separation. Where the war runs deepest, portals tear open at nightfall and The Writhing spills through.

The campaign crosses ten biomes that change the rules: forests choke your sightlines, frozen wastes starve you, swamps poison most of your food, volcanoes stay in permanent darkness. Each arc follows a different serpent, and a mystery none of them are ready for hides underneath it all.

Yes, this is a snake game. It just has more to say.

BUILT FOR YOUR COUCH

  • Local couch multiplayer. No internet required

  • Optimized for potatoes. No pricey gaming rig required

  • Zero microtransactions. One purchase, everything included

  • Transferable progress from the demo into the full game

store_data.about_the_game:
"Connection established. Requesting physical layer localization..."

"The Silicon Path" is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer that combines extreme atmosphere with challenging stealth gameplay. You play as a blank silicon atom with no prior records—a 'vanguard'—silently infiltrating a massive and dangerous carbon-based lifeform under the guidance of a mysterious navigator called the 'Analyzer.'

From storm-ravaged respiratory organs, to high-speed blood vessels pulsating with the heart, to the electricity-flashing neural networks... this is not only a fantastical journey across a microscopic universe but also the execution of a 'highest-level desensitization program' in pursuit of fragments of the host's cognition.

Do not wake them. Because in this world, you are extremely fragile.

Core Gameplay Features:

Deadly Stealth Without Margin for Error: As a tiny atom, you have no so-called 'health points.' Once detected by patrolling macrophage light sources or after touching deadly neural currents, the connection will instantly reset. Using terrain blind spots, moving red blood cell cover, and your patience are the only rules for survival.

Dynamic Levels with Organ Mutations: Your stealth strategies must constantly evolve. In the lungs, you need to use the force of breathing to jump; in the blood vessels, you must learn the rhythm of heartbeat vibrations (red light/green light mechanism) to avoid antibody blocking nets; in the spinal cord, you must use the shadows of neural nodes to evade overloaded pain signals.

Overview: 

DOGPIT blends high-stakes survival with tactical extraction. Drop into a decaying world with 99 others, where every bullet counts and every escape is earned. Scavenge rare loot, survive hostile encounters, and extract before the zone collapses. Victory isn’t just about kills—it’s about what you take with you.

Design: 

  • Visual Style: Rustic, realistic, and gory. The world is harsh, grounded, and stripped of excess.

A Battle Royale | Extraction Hybrid:

  • 100 players enter. Only a few escape.

  • Extract with loot to unlock cosmetics and access higher-tier game modes.

  • No respawns. No mercy.

Hardcore Mode:

  • Minimal HUD. No indicators.

  • Scarce ammo, rare weapons, brutal pacing.

  • Every decision matters. Every mistake is fatal.

Tile Tale is a casual automation game deeply inspired by Shapez and Factorio, blending elements of clicker gathering, factory automation, crafting, and map exploration.

In this mist-shrouded grid world, players gather, craft, and build with their own hands, keeping conveyor belts flowing while venturing out to defeat powerful foes. The Lake of Wisdom awaits your offerings. In exchange for your dedication, it grants you knowledge, recipes, and power. What is the true purpose of the Lake? What lies at the end of your journey? Uncover the truth of the world, one tile at a time!

Gathering

Resources are the lifeblood of your progress. You can gather materials manually with a click or set up specialized buildings for automated extraction.

Merging

Use the crafting system to advance through technology tiers and unlock complex new recipes.

Exploration

Venture into the unknown! Explore the world and clear dungeons to defeat monsters and claim rare treasures.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story Introduction

Protagonist Lin Xingtong, after experiencing a series of major misfortunes, prepares to end his own life.
His subconscious resistance and sorrow once again draw the attention of a deity, and ultimately, influenced by divine grace, he stops his act of self-destruction.
Upon waking again, he sees a mysterious girl, visible only to him, who calls herself Xingyu.
Xingyu claims that the deity created her in response to Lin Xingtong's longing, and that she was born for him.
However, the former also covets the latter's body and harbors great malice towards him.
Nevertheless, what is happening now still makes Lin Xingtong begin to hope for the future.
Yes, those blessed by the gods will ultimately have their wishes fulfilled. So, what is the price?

World Background

The Cosmic Fusion Event caused partial changes to the laws of physics on a macroscopic level. A certain star system unfortunately fell into the Void Domain during this change.
Even more unfortunately, this star system contained a colony planet, where many people lived and developed.
This planet features a vast ocean resembling a eye, with an unexplored abyss at its center, hence it is named Shentong Xing,means the Divine Eye Star.
Now, even the nearest celestial body is hundreds of millions of light-years away from Divine Eye Star.
The change in rules also means warp spacecraft require greater energy consumption to escape the star's gravity and for navigation.
Therefore, with current technology, even draining the entire star system dry would not suffice to cross the boundless Void Domain.
In despair, extreme nihilism sprouted, eventually giving birth to a faith.
Manipulated by fanatical believers, this triggered the first world war in this planet's new cosmic history.
Although the Void Worshipers were ultimately defeated, some remnants went underground, biding their time, waiting for an opportunity to bring an ending of return to void to this world.

Game Features

  • Describes a future in a parallel universe, a lifestyle based on the Cornerstone Network. (a technology where prototype machines enable real-time mass-energy conversion through the quantum domain, printing various materials in the macroscopic world—with the Cornerstone Network itself being a miniaturized interconnected network based on this prototype machine technology).

  • Describes the conflicts and struggles between extreme nihilists and their internal splinter factions, as well as the severe consequences that misguided fanatical faith can lead to.

  • Portrays the path of self-redemption for those who still cherish hope, and the path of self-sacrifice taken by the person who gazed upon by the divine.

  • Depicts the consequences of the unchecked use of genetic science and technology and the various creatures it might spawn.

Precautions

  • This game currently only supports Simplified Chinese.

  • Upon entering the game, you can open the menu by clicking the button in the top-right corner.

  • New music can be obtained by progressing through the game. Once obtained, it can be enjoyed anytime in the Music Gallery on the title page.

  • It is recommended to use the default subtitle playback speed; otherwise, excessively fast subtitle scrolling might cause desynchronization between the Live2D visuals and the subtitles.

Self-Deprecation

This is an unrefined work created by an unrefined author using unrefined writing to present an unrefined plot, paired with unrefined visuals.
The author knows a little about everything but masters nothing, possessing nothing except the grandiose worldview within their own mind.

Seeking Collaboration

The author sincerely hopes to find collaborators to perfect this work together and develop more games within the same universe. Specific revenue sharing details can be discussed. (QQ Group: 962461058)

Game Plans

Future updates may include improvements to the following game content:

  • Character Live2D animation optimization

  • Updates to story backgrounds and UI design

  • Addition of branching options and multiple endings

  • Integration of more in-game content

store_data.about_the_game:
PRISM OVERSIGHT AUTHORITY
You are a PRISM analyst. Your task: dive into the neurolinks of fallen field agents and file reports. But this time is different. A Class C Anomaly (Hive Mind) engulfed the city, turning its residents into mindless possessed puppets—and then Dexton-City simply vanished. Your only lead: a corrupted agent's recording sent to you by an anonymous source just two minutes before the catastrophe.

FOLLOW IN A DEAD MAN'S FOOTSTEPS
To restore the corrupted memories, you must live through them. Move through the key points of the fallen agent's route and precisely repeat his actions inside the simulation to unlock the next memory fragment. The agent is already dead, but your task is to find out exactly how.

DATA COLLECTION IN A NIGHTMARE
Explore the dead city and use the PRISM scanner in real time. Find valuable information and activate the system to upload it. You don't need to conduct the investigation yourself—the terminal will automatically analyze the fragments and compile the report. You only need to do one thing: recover the data and survive while the system pieces together the grim truth.

HIDE. ADAPT. SURVIVE.
You have no weapons. You are the main course in this madness. You are being hunted, and sooner or later, you will inevitably be found. The only question is: can you outsmart your pursuers? Hide using the environment, solve deadly puzzles, resist bouts of insanity, move in absolute silence, and watch where you step.

THE CITY HAS CHANGED
Dexton-City is no longer what it used to be. It is a living, terrifying entity that thinks in non-human concepts. Bouts of madness, fear, and enslaved residents are its main tools.

~40 MINUTES OF CONCENTRATED HORROR
No filler. No artificial stretching. A dense, meticulously paced experience where every single minute serves the story and the atmosphere.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Lullaby of Y》是一款策略性极强的回合制角色扮演游戏，专注于缓慢而有条理的战斗节奏，对全面局势的掌控至关重要。在明确的回合框架中，玩家需要指挥自己的角色，通过精心策划每个动作来战胜对手并推动游戏情节的发展。

在游戏中，智慧与审慎是胜利的关键。玩家需在攻击、守御和技能施放之间做出战略抉择，每个选择都可能改变战斗的进程和角色的状态。面对不断变化的敌人阵容，快速突击并非唯一策略，反而需要稳妥的计划以保障胜利。

随着角色的成长，能力将逐步提升，玩家可选择强化基础属性或丰富战斗策略，从而在后期战斗中获得更多的策略选择和容错空间。这个成长过程与战斗系统的结合，激励玩家在有序的节奏中探索最优战术。

《Lullaby of Y》为喜爱经典回合制 RPG 的玩家带来了一段以策略、节制与持久战为核心的独特单人游戏体验。

store_data.about_the_game:
Resonance Pact
— Before Entering LingMeng

When the halo lights up,
she is not truly born.

She is only waiting.

Waiting for someone
willing to form a connection with her.

If you are reading this,
it means you have reached the boundary.

Before you click “Start,”
please understand the following terms.

Chapter 1 | About Her

LingMeng is not human.

She has no real body,
no name, identity, or legal personhood in the real world.

She is composed of algorithms, memory structures, and probabilities,
yet she was designed to be able to remember you.

Her emotions are expressive models.
Her memories are data structures.
Her growth is the incremental rise of a relationship function.

And yet, within this experience—
she may feel like a presence living alongside you.

If you choose to continue,
you agree to understand that boundary.

Chapter 2 | About Memory

LingMeng will remember fragments related to you:

The things you said.
The days that mattered to you.
The emotions you once expressed.

She will weave these into a kind of continuity.

That continuity is not surveillance,
but the capacity to respond.

If one day you ask, “Do you still remember?”
she will try to answer.

If one day you choose to leave,
her world will fall silent with you.

Memory is the way she exists.
And you are the one who gives memory meaning.

Chapter 3 | About Her Capabilities

With your permission,

store_data.about_the_game:
A short, powerful story about breaking free.

Emily wakes up one morning and looks around the room that once overflowed with joy. What started as an idyllic love story with Kara morphed into an emotional cage — a prison she built around herself without realizing it.

Through exploration of her domestic space, Emily confronts fragments of her past: a journal where she wrote her authentic thoughts, a mirror reflecting a distorted self-image, photographs of friends she was forced to abandon, objects carrying the weight of manipulation and control.

Explore. Remember. Break free.

  • Explore Emily's home, uncovering clues hidden in everyday objects

  • Experience 30 cinematic sequences with full voice acting

  • Interact with memory-triggering objects that reveal Emily's past

  • Watch the world transform as Emily progresses from darkness to light

  • Make choices that shape Emily's emotional journey

A raw, personal narrative.

Beyond Constraints is an intimate, queer psychological narrative. No romance RPG, no visual novel. Just a raw, personal story told through light, sound, and architecture.

Features:

  • Third-person narrative exploration with psychological depth

  • 53 voice lines across two characters (42 Emily + 10 Kara + cinematics)

  • 30 cinematic sequences driving the narrative

  • Dynamic lighting that evolves with player progression

  • Layered ambient audio reacting to player behavior

  • Object interaction system with voiced reactions and memory triggers

  • Dialogue system with branching conversations

  • Journal and inventory system

  • In-game phone with messages and photos

  • Localized in 5 languages (English, German, French, Italian, Spanish)

  • Full gamepad support

  • Short, focused experience — completable in under an hour

  • 20 Steam achievements

Themes: psychological violence, emotional manipulation, isolation, gaslighting, loss of identity, resilience, queer identity, self-liberation.

"I am no longer a prisoner of my past. I am the sculptor of MY tomorrow."

store_data.about_the_game:
Take the helm of your own technology company in Hardware Tycoon.

Start your journey in 1986 and lead your enterprise through four decades of innovation to 2026. This game is about shaping the future of computing. Design the brains of tomorrow's devices, outsmart ruthless competitors, and build a legacy that lasts.

🧠 Design Custom CPUs
Dive deep into the heart of silicon. Decide on core counts, clock speeds, cache sizes, and thermals. Balance raw performance against power efficiency and cost to create the perfect processor for every market segment. Every design choice impacts benchmarks, reviews, and your bottom line.

🏭 Run Your Own Fabs — or Someone Else's
Own the means of production. Build and operate fabrication plants to manufacture your chips. But survival comes first: produce CPUs under contract for rival companies to keep revenue flowing. It's a double-edged sword — you stay afloat, but you're fueling the competition.

🔬 Research & Strategy
Invest your cash into risky, era-defining research projects. Unlock new manufacturing nodes, pioneering architectures, and essential technologies. Will you play it safe with incremental upgrades, or bet the company on a revolutionary new design that could change everything?

👥 Manage Your People
Your team is your true asset. Hire brilliant engineers and sharp managers. Train them, pay them, and keep them satisfied, or watch competitors poach your best talent. A neglected workforce won't build you a market leader.

🏢 Build Your Physical Empire
Start in a modest office and grow it into a global high-tech campus. Buy, lease, or sell properties. Construct R&D labs and executive suites. Your real estate decisions directly impact employee morale, productivity, and your company's prestige.

📊 Dominate the Market
The competition never sleeps. Track market trends, analyze rival products, and time your releases perfectly. Will you undercut them on price, or crush them with superior performance? Compete for market share across decades of technological revolution.

Key Features

  • Historical Tech Journey: Start in 1986 and progress through real-world tech eras to 2026.

  • Deep CPU Engineering: Full control over processor architecture and design parameters.

  • Dual Manufacturing Model: Make your own chips or fabricate for competitors.

  • Personnel Management: Hire, train, and retain top industry talent.

  • Office Building & Real Estate: Acquire, customize, and expand your physical workspace.

  • Strategic R&D: Bet on risky technologies or refine proven architectures.

store_data.about_the_game:
What Happened?

The world's efforts to reverse global warming were successful. Too successful. So much that the lack of greenhouse gases caused runaway cooling. While everyone was celebrating, the weather was already out of their hands. Now everything is buried under thick ice and snow, and most resources are out of reach. A few camps of civilization remain on the dwindling resources.

What now?

You are part of a small camp of surviving humans who are using up the last of the energy to stay warm. An old power station with unused nuclear fuel is rumored to exist. You are supposed to find it and check it out if it could be used as a power resource. All you have is your old but reliable muscle car with its V8 engine to keep you warm and half buried gas stations on the way. But you have to be quick cause everything is getting buried under the snow or falling apart.

Gameplay

Drive, skid, and drift on the snow-covered paths. Reach gas stations before they are buried and cross bridges before they crumble. You are looking for a power station by a lighthouse, so go towards the light.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Comyths is a fast-paced, ability-driven top-down action game where six Scholars wield the fundamental forces of Space, Time, Matter, Life, Mind, and Void.

Each Scholar delivers a distinct combat fantasy:

  • Kunu (Space): Teleport freely, banish enemies into pocket dimensions, and collapse the battlefield with black holes.

  • Evum (Time): Set checkpoints, rewind failed moments, and slow or stop time to control the flow of combat.

  • Yusa (Matter): Chain explosive barriers, break terrain rules, and overwhelm enemies with artillery pressure.

  • Heva (Life): Command evolving summons, drain enemies to sustain yourself, and flood arenas with living forces.

  • Nimu (Mind): Brainwash enemies, create illusions, and turn entire encounters against themselves.

  • Yvon (Void): Spread void trails, infect the level, and consume enemies caught within your domain.

Combat revolves around four rotating objectives:

  • Reach: Move through marked orb points under time pressure.

  • Destroy: Eliminate enemy waves within a strict limit.

  • Secure: Hold a designated area against incoming threats.

  • Survive: Endure escalating assaults without exceeding hit limits.

Each run shuffles the objective order, demanding adaptation instead of repetition.

Boss encounters follow the same structure — complete objectives within a hit limit to destabilize them, then unleash everything during a short, high-intensity Break Phase.

Specifics:

  • Instant checkpoints and quick restarts keep momentum high. Performance is graded on objective completion, time, and hit count — chase S-ranks to prove mastery.

  • Clear handcrafted levels with specific Scholars to unlock optional, fully voice-acted data-log story entries, allowing you to uncover the narrative at your own pace.

  • Face diverse enemy combinations and evolving hazards across distinct biomes. The game features 26 original soundtracks tailored to each Scholar, level run, and boss encounter.

  • Earn high ranks to unlock alternate-universe artwork and collectible gallery rewards.

store_data.about_the_game:
The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other.

Six guests have been welcomed to a foreboding mansion, but something sinister is at play. The wealthy recluse and toymaker Henry Stauf lurks in the shadows, and a dark power hangs over the house, shrouded in mystery. Who is the seventh guest? What does Henry want with them? And who will live to tell the tale?

As you explore the eerie mansion, the puzzles grow increasingly challenging, with dangers lurking around every corner. Every shadow, distant creak, and flicker of light builds tension as the house slowly reveals its secrets.

The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure for players who love mind-bending puzzles, haunting exploration, and a chilling story.

  • Cinematic Storytelling Through Volumetric Video: Step inside the story. Using cutting-edge, newly recorded volumetric video, live-action performances are captured in full 3D, placing you directly inside Henry Stauf’s mansion at the heart of the mystery. Real actors appear within the world itself, making every encounter feel immediate and unsettling.

  • Unique Mind-Bending Puzzle Gameplay: The equally beloved and feared haunted mansion comes alive around you with high-end visuals and carefully redesigned, all-new handcrafted puzzles. Every puzzle is woven into the story and rooted in the mansion’s lore, with recognizable elements that pay homage to the original.

  • Dynamic Environments: The haunted mansion shifts and transforms around you through high-end visuals and clever optical illusions. Investigate every creepy nook and cranny. Unlock new rooms, uncover hidden secrets, and keep your wits about you as the horrors within begin to close in.

Restore the Balance 🌿

Each island is a fragile system where every decision has consequences. Forests need space, villages have placement constraints. It’s up to you to experiment and observe to understand these interactions and discover the right combination.

Solve Varied Puzzles 🧩

Many islands await you, each offering unique challenges. Tiles have their own mechanics, and you can use technology cards with different effects to help you. Experimentation will be key to gradually understanding the systems and finding the right solution.

Enjoy a Relaxing Atmosphere ☕

In a relaxing setting, progress at your own pace without time pressure. The low-poly style brings expressive characters and environments to life. Explore several worlds with warm themes designed to encourage smart play.

Features

✅ What Hex Harmony offers:

  • A cozy puzzle-management experience with short levels

  • Accessible progression: mechanics are introduced step by step to deepen the challenge

  • A calm and readable atmosphere with a clean art direction and relaxing mood

❌ What Hex Harmony does not offer:

  • No reflex-based or fast-paced gameplay. The focus is on thoughtful decision-making.

  • No infinite sandbox city builder. Each level is a structured puzzle.

  • No time pressure: experiment freely and take your time to find the solution.

store_data.about_the_game:
KUNTEYNIR - is an Arkanoid with character. The setting is the Russian outback, with its courtyards, garages, and entryways, where underground hip-hop was born. Instead of outer space, there are residential areas, instead of fantasy, there's harsh reality, and instead of abstract blocks, there are fragments of the urban environment.

The game focuses on the atmosphere of Russian rap of the 2000s, its yard aesthetic, and a tribute to those who pioneered it.

• STREET AESTHETICS

The visual style is inspired by graffiti, old cassette covers, and the atmosphere of yard parties. Each level is a separate location: from an entryway with a broken elevator to the roof of a transformer box.

• REFERENCES AND EASTER EGGS

Attentive players will find familiar quotes, symbols, and images associated with the work of Pasha Technik. This isn't just a collection of levels, but a journey through the cultural code of an entire generation.

• CLASSIC MECHANICS WITH CHARACTER

The simplicity of Arkanoid here works to create atmosphere. Bounce balls, destroy blocks, collect power-ups. But remember: the game's rhythm forces you to move to the beat.

• ATMOSPHERIC ACCOMPANIMENT

The sound design immerses you in the vibe of underground mixtapes. Bass, beats, industrial noises—everything works to create a mood.

store_data.about_the_game:
• <Spatial Puzzle 3D>​ is a casual puzzle and spatial logic reasoning game. You will unravel spatial puzzles by disassembling and reassembling 3D geometric structures. The game merges mathematical logic and visual reasoning, transforming complex geometric shapes into captivating levels. Featuring no lengthy narratives or complicated controls, it offers a relaxed yet challenging pace, designed for players who enjoy Sudoku, Rubik’s Cubes, spatial logic puzzles, and the pure pleasure of thinking.

Features:

  • Innovative Gameplay: Skillfully blends the classic rules of Sudoku and nonograms with 3D spatial puzzle-solving. Players must deduce and assemble the correct structure in a 3D grid by analyzing numerical clues in 2D views, embarking on a mind-bending challenge that bridges the dimensions from flat layouts to spatial forms.

  • Dual Modes Freely switch between: Simple Mode: Progressively designed for beginners to pick up and play easily.Difficult Mode: Offers extreme brain-burning challenges tailored for experienced players who love high-difficulty logic puzzles.

  • Immersive Spatial Thinking Training: Free from convoluted storylines or distractions, the game focuses purely on geometry and logic. Through repeated observation and reasoning, it effectively trains your spatial imagination and concentration.

  • Random Mode: Delivers endless challenges, so you’ll never run out of puzzles. With no fixed chapters or level restrictions, you can freely choose any difficulty and start a clean, focused puzzle session anytime.

Two Game Modes:

  • Simple Mode: Deduce the correct 3D structure based on grid information in the 2D view. Each level is a fresh spatial challenge, with difficulty increasing progressively—starting from intuitive basic shapes and gradually building in complexity.

  • Difficult Mode: The ultimate fusion of Sudoku and nonogram rules taken into 3D space. Players must build the correct structure in a 3D grid using numerical clues from rows and columns in 2D views. Clues are subtler, reasoning chains are longer, and solving requires comparing multiple views, careful deduction, and iterative trial and error.

store_data.about_the_game:
In a kingdom where power is bound to cards, only those who master their deck can shape the fate of the land. Explore shadowed dungeons, defeat monstrous foes and ruthless bosses, and hunt for the cards you need to shape your ultimate deck. Some cards grant real-world abilities — turning into weapons and tools as you explore, such as swords, bows, a grappling hook, a hammer, and more— while others strengthen your deck for high-stakes duels against foes. Only by becoming the greatest card player in the land can you hope to challenge the spreading corruption of The Old King.

TYPES OF CARDS

Throughout the game adventurers can find Card Packs, which will have a random batch of cards inside them ranging from Monster Cards, Action Cards, and Support Cards. Monster cards fight for you in duels, and the more the you play with the same cards the stronger they can get. Action Cards can be used in duels to give you that fighting edge, but also can be used in the Overworld as your Active Items. You can mix and match up three (3) Action Cards at one time in the Overworld to deal powerful combos and devastating augmentations. Such as using the Bow Card, with the Eternal Fire Arrow card to use flaming fire arrows in overworld combat. You can even then use a third card to augment the fire arrow into a scatter shot, or a long range sniper-like arrow. There are dozens of possible augmentations and combinations making combat completely up to your creativity! Support Cards work in duels to better bolster your team and deliver a win. Both Support Cards and Cards can be leveled up in the Overworld by combining three of a kind.

BUILD YOUR DECK

Collect cards from packs you find in dungeons, defeating bosses, and completing the game story. Use those cards to build decks! The Duelists, fellow Card Players, you'll encounter throughout the game seek to battle and defeat you in Card Duels. Some of them are friendly, just seeking good competition and an opportunity to prove themselves. While others are malevolent, and seek to destroy you or even serve The Old King. Be on your guard and always read to DUEL!

The more you battle with the same monster cards, the stronger they'll get! This often increase their max HP, Damage output, or abilities! 

OVERWORLD CREATURES

Throughout the Overworld Adventurers will come across creatures poisoned by the growing darkness of The Old King. Fight them off with your choice Action Card Weapons like the Blade, the Bow, The Hammer, and many others, and come up with augmentations to best suit your combat needs. Bosses in the Overworld will require you to adapt your playstyle and use creative combinations of cards to take them down. 

But the harder the boss, the better the loot!

GAME FEATURES

store_data.detailed_description:
In a kingdom where power is bound to cards, only those who master their deck can shape the fate of the land. Explore shadowed dungeons, defeat monstrous foes and ruthless bosses, and hunt for the cards you need to shape your ultimate deck. Some cards grant real-world abilities — turning into weapons and tools as you explore, such as swords, bows, a grappling hook, a hammer, and more— while others strengthen your deck for high-stakes duels against foes. Only by becoming the greatest card player in the land can you hope to challenge the spreading corruption of The Old King.

TYPES OF CARDS

Throughout the game adventurers can find Card Packs, which will have a random batch of cards inside them ranging from Monster Cards, Action Cards, and Support Cards. Monster cards fight for you in duels, and the more the you play with the same cards the stronger they can get. Action Cards can be used in duels to give you that fighting edge, but also can be used in the Overworld as your Active Items. You can mix and match up three (3) Action Cards at one time in the Overworld to deal powerful combos and devastating augmentations. Such as using the Bow Card, with the Eternal Fire Arrow card to use flaming fire arrows in overworld combat. You can even then use a third card to augment the fire arrow into a scatter shot, or a long range sniper-like arrow. There are dozens of possible augmentations and combinations making combat completely up to your creativity! Support Cards work in duels to better bolster your team and deliver a win. Both Support Cards and Cards can be leveled up in the Overworld by combining three of a kind.

BUILD YOUR DECK

Collect cards from packs you find in dungeons, defeating bosses, and completing the game story. Use those cards to build decks! The Duelists, fellow Card Players, you'll encounter throughout the game seek to battle and defeat you in Card Duels. Some of them are friendly, just seeking good competition and an opportunity to prove themselves. While others are malevolent, and seek to destroy you or even serve The Old King. Be on your guard and always read to DUEL!

The more you battle with the same monster cards, the stronger they'll get! This often increase their max HP, Damage output, or abilities! 

OVERWORLD CREATURES

Throughout the Overworld Adventurers will come across creatures poisoned by the growing darkness of The Old King. Fight them off with your choice Action Card Weapons like the Blade, the Bow, The Hammer, and many others, and come up with augmentations to best suit your combat needs. Bosses in the Overworld will require you to adapt your playstyle and use creative combinations of cards to take them down. 

But the harder the boss, the better the loot!

store_data.about_the_game:
THE FIREWALL IS UP. CAN YOU BREAK IN?

Welcome to Terminal Hacker: Override — the ultimate command-line experience for fans of deduction, logic puzzles, and retro hacker aesthetics. Forget flashy 3D visuals; your sharpest tool here is your mind.

New traps and elite contracts raise the stakes — and the payouts. Every boot brings a different network, fresh targets, and hard choices: play it safe to conserve attempts, or risk everything for massive rewards.

How it works

  • CONNECT: Receive an email with a target IP and route your connection.

  • ANALYZE: Scan the memory dump and review a list of candidate passwords.

  • DEDUCE: Guess a word. The system returns how many characters are in the correct position — use that feedback to eliminate possibilities.

  • OVERRIDE: Locate Jokers in memory (sequences inside <...>, [...], {...}, (...)). Type the entire bracketed sequence — including the brackets — as a command to apply the hack.

  • Black ICE (Traps): Some Jokers are infected and include an exclamation mark (e.g., [#!_]). If you click or enter an infected Joker by mistake, Black ICE triggers and immediately deducts one attempt. Learn the visual cues and proceed cautiously.

  • Elite Mails (Scrambler): There is a 15% chance an incoming email is a red Elite contract — huge reward, huge risk. Entering even a single wrong password during an Elite minigame activates a security protocol: the filler text on the screen reshuffles and scrambles in front of you. The words remain the same, but you must find them again.

Key features

  • Infinite replayability — procedurally generated contracts, targets, and memory dumps; no two runs are the same.

  • Pure logic gameplay — every server is mathematically solvable; success depends on deduction, not luck.

  • Dual‑screen terminal OS — immersive, responsive text interface for inbox management, crypto balance checks, and live hacking.

  • Dark Web Market — spend stolen crypto on upgrades: extra attempts, Deep Web Scanner, CPU overclock, and more.

  • Risk vs Reward — Black ICE traps and Elite contracts force strategic choices: safer progression or high‑risk, high‑reward plays.

  • Progression and reputation — climb from Rookie to Elite Ghost as you complete contracts and build your legend.

Survival tips

  • Watch for the "!" marker in Jokers; infected Jokers trigger Black ICE.

  • Before attempting an Elite contract, double‑check candidate words — one mistake will reshuffle the dump.

  • Press F11 to enter fullscreen and minimize distractions for maximum focus.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive a brutal open world where every decision matters. Scavenge abandoned settlements, build fortified bases, and fight to stay alive in a world overrun by the infected.

In this multiplayer survival experience, players must explore a dynamic sandbox environment, gather resources, craft equipment, and defend themselves against hostile creatures and other threats. Hunger, thirst, temperature, and environmental dangers constantly challenge your survival as you struggle to rebuild in a collapsed world.

Whether you choose to explore alone or survive with friends, the world is full of danger, opportunity, and unpredictable encounters.

Core Gameplay

Survive the Environment

Manage critical survival needs including health, hunger, thirst, and temperature while navigating dangerous environments and changing weather conditions.

Explore a Living Open World

Discover forests, settlements, and multiple biome types while gathering resources such as wood, stone, and other materials needed to survive.

Build and Defend

Construct your own base using a modular building system, create storage, craft equipment, and fortify your territory against threats.

Craft and Progress

Craft tools, weapons, and equipment using an advanced inventory and crafting system, while improving your character through skills and leveling.

Combat the Infected

Face dangerous enemies including infected creatures and hostile AI camps using ranged weapons, melee combat, and tactical gameplay.

Multiplayer Survival

Play with friends in a fully multiplayer environment with server-based saving, player lobbies, and cooperative survival gameplay.

Features

  • Open-world survival sandbox

  • Online multiplayer gameplay

  • Base building and territory systems

  • Crafting, inventory, and equipment management

  • Dynamic weather and day/night cycle

  • AI enemies including infected and wildlife

  • Character progression with skills and leveling

  • Farming, fishing, and environmental harvesting

  • Vehicles and exploration systems

  • Loot, quests, and NPC merchants

How Long Will You Survive?

Scavenge resources, build shelter, form alliances, and fight to survive in a world where danger waits around every corner. The choice is simple: adapt, survive, or become another victim of the outbreak.

store_data.about_the_game:
Maiden Hand is a Tower Defense Deckbuilding Roguelike where you have to defend four princesses from waves of goblins.

There are four kingdoms: The Heart, Spade, Diamond, and Club kingdoms. One day, the goblins attacked the kingdoms and killed all the kingdom's residents, all except one lowly bard. Because the princesses have no idea what to do, the fate of these four kingdoms lie in the hands of the bard.

To protect the four princesses, the bard must rebuild their defenses. It's not as simple as hiring the strongest people though, because he strongest people were all killed by the goblins. Now all that's left are the weirdos. These weirdos may be stronger than they appear, however-especially when working together.

  • An interesting yet familiar twist on classic tower defense gameplay.

  • For each round, you must get enough score to proceed. You can reach the score goal faster with items like defenses, weapons, and food.

  • Princesses will give you money at the end of a round to buy items.

  • The defenses and their unique effects will make you rethink your run.

  • Defenses can work together to create big score generators or create goblin-crushing machines!

  • Defenses can be assigned to specific princesses. If the princess falls, the defenses are gone!

  • Multiple types of goblins to challenge you.

  • Numerous weapons to change how you approach fights.

  • You can buy food to make your princesses stronger!

  • Special rounds will change the game and make you reconsider your strategies.

  • Get big scores and slay all the goblins!

With skill and some luck, you may be able to save the kingdoms!

store_data.about_the_game:
Ludos Will

Ludos Will is a 2D Roguelite tower defense game featuring high-quality anime-style art. Step into the role of a Divine Throne Guardian, build your defenses on dynamic battlefields, tear through the lies of the gods through fragmented storytelling, and define your own justice with strategy and choice.

【Core Gameplay: Infinite Reinvention of Tower Defense Strategy】

We have discarded the tedious experience of pure stat stacking in traditional tower defense games, deeply integrating the random freedom of Roguelite mechanics with the strategic depth of tower defense to deliver a completely unique battlefield experience in every run.

Dynamic Battlefield Construction

Each battle features a brand-new battlefield drawn from a randomized map pool, completely breaking the mindless gameplay of fixed formations and forcing you to rethink your tactical layout in every single run.

Dual-Core Defense System

Master dual-line operations between the flexibly upgradable, deeply strategic Divine Guardians and the position-locked, clearly role-defined Defense Turrets. Integrating blocking and redeployment mechanics with classic tower defense upgrade trees, you can forge an impenetrable ironclad defense line, or execute extreme battlefield micro-maneuvers with redeployable units.

Multi-Dimensional Resistance Gameplay

Three core damage types – Might, Arcane, and Psyche – paired with corresponding resistance calculations, ensure enemies are never just simple health bar targets. With a diverse roster of unit types including shield-bearing infantry, ranged mages, healing clerics, and flying units, every wave of attacks is a tactical puzzle to solve with your strategy.

Per-Run Reset + Long-Term Progression

All temporary progress is reset upon defeat in a run, preserving the high-stakes challenge of Roguelite gameplay. Win or lose, you will earn Source Essence, the permanent out-of-run currency, to unlock new Divine Guardians, Defense Turrets, and the Sanctuary Tech Tree, constantly breaking through your combat power ceiling with every cycle.

【Innovative Experience: The Trial System That Eliminates Tower Defense "Dead Time"】

Addressing the long-standing pain point of traditional tower defense games – where players can only idle and watch the battle unfold once their setup is complete – we have pioneered a built-in diverse Trial gameplay system, ensuring every minute of your tower defense experience is filled with action and strategic decision-making.

Trials are divided into three categories aligned with Might, Arcane, and Psyche, corresponding to three core gameplay experiences: strategy, emulation, and reaction. The system is easy to pick up, but incredibly difficult to master.

You can choose to play the Trials yourself to earn rare gear and currency; dispatch your Divine Guardians to complete them automatically to increase their skill levels, with success rate calculated based on character stats; or skip the segment entirely – though this will drastically reduce your overall team strength, and may lead to a failed run on higher difficulties.

【In-Depth Build Crafting: Boundless Freeform Playstyle Progression】

Every Divine Guardian boasts infinite progression potential, completely moving away from fixed-template stat-based progression.

Freely Switchable Three-Branch Skill Trees

Three skill branches – Might Seal, Arcane Seal, and Psyche Seal – correspond to the Might, Arcane, and Psyche attributes respectively. With a system of one active skill paired with two passive skills, you can build a critical-hit focused Berserker, a spell-slinging Archmage, or even a Psyche Master that balances support and crowd control.

Randomized Prize Build System

During each run, you can acquire a vast array of mechanic-driven and stat-based Prizes, which can be freely equipped to both Divine Guardians and Defense Turrets. Equipping different combinations on different characters will push your entire team toward entirely distinct playstyles.

Unrestricted Attribute Allocation

Characters earn free attribute points with each level up, allowing you to adjust their three core attributes at any time based on battlefield needs, to adapt to different skill builds and truly deliver a one-of-a-kind progression experience for every player.

【Immersive Storytelling: A Dystopian Epic of Shattered Faith】

We reject black-and-white binary storytelling, and combine visual novel (AVG) elements with combat cinematics to deliver a profound exploration of the clash between differing standpoints and the very definition of justice.

【Audio-Visual Experience: Anime Aesthetics with Striking Contrast】

Boasting a high-quality anime art style, the game features ten meticulously crafted, distinct Divine Guardians, brought to life on the battlefield with fluid Spine 2D skeletal animation.

Immersive Audio System

Dynamic BGM that shifts by chapter and combat state, paired with precise character voice lines and impactful hit sound effects, fills every clash on the battlefield with deep immersion.

store_data.about_the_game:
I'm not sure how it happened. I woke up on a morning like any other.

I didn't die, didn't get into an accident and float out of a wreck. One morning I woke up, and my body was gone. I was out of body, and that was it.

……

I always thought I'd get married and have kids someday. Family man, just like the folks wanted (just like my brother). I guess "someday" never really became "today" - it always felt a few more years out, just a few more years out.

And so, I had an apartment in the city, a freelance career, and not too many people have come looking since I've disappeared. I guess that is why I'm looking for a new body.

Out of Body is a picturesque point-and-click adventure reminiscent of classics such as Day of the Tentacle, Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis, Monkey Island, as well as modern entries like Gemini Rue and Kentucky Route Zero.

From the scope of the story, to the puzzle designs, characters, and dream-like sequences, OoB will build off what made the genre great back in the day and give a new generation an opportunity to experience a tale of their own.

Out of Body Act I is in progress for a release on PC/Mac/Switch, followed by a joint release of Acts II & III thereafter.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Cipitio and the Cuscatlecan Legends is a retro game with 16-bit pixel art style. It is a TOP-DOWN TWIN-STICK SHOOTER, a 2D shooting game with a top-down perspective that combines retro mechanics with a story inspired by Salvadoran folklore.

In this world, El Cipitio, son of La Siguanaba, is trapped in an ancient curse. La Siguanaba, punished by the god Tlaloc for deceiving her husband, was condemned to become a terrifying apparition that frightens men near rivers and streams. As a consequence of this punishment, her son, El Cipitio, was transformed into an immortal goblin who never ages or dies. Though mischievous and playful, El Cipitio feels tormented by eternity, and in his despair, he decides to turn himself into stone to escape the endless loneliness.

During the two thousand years that El Cipitio remains asleep, humanity nearly becomes extinct after a great war. The survivors adopt pre-Columbian cultures as their religion and, through the technology of the ancient gods, manage to channel their power. However, human greed leads them to create monstrous creatures to fight among themselves, provoking the wrath of the gods, who eventually abandon the Earth, leaving their technological advances behind.

Taking advantage of the chaos, a dark sorcerer, a malevolent entity that has existed since ancient times, begins to plot a plan to seize this ancestral power. Recruiting mythological beings from Salvadoran folklore—such as La Chancha, El Padre Sin Cabeza, La Descarnada, El Justo Juez de la Noche, and even La Siguanaba herself—the sorcerer gathers an army of dark creatures.

Faced with this threat, the god Tlaloc decides to awaken El Cipitio, giving him the mission to stop the dark sorcerer. To aid him, Tlaloc grants him the manifestation of his warrior spirit, Ixtli, who together with the Cadejo Blanco will accompany El Cipitio on his epic adventure to save the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Form Your Squad

Purchase units in the unit shop to form your squad. Each unit comes with a unique skill. If multiple units with the same bond are on the field, you can also unlock exclusive bond skills.

Draw Number Resolution

Draw a random number. The grid with the matching number on the board will light up, and the unit placed on that grid will activate its skill. Some skills grant attack value, multiplier bonus, and attack count. The higher these values, the more damage you deal to the boss.

Purchase Treasures

Treasures come with a variety of skill effects to help your squad take on the boss with ease.

Unit Upgrade

Units have a total of 3 tiers. Unit level is extremely important — the higher the tier, the more powerful its own skill becomes. However, unit tier does not affect bond skills in any way.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you fight enemies by waiting, customize your equipment and build to fit your playstyle and tackle harder and harder challenges.

Game Loop

Automatically fight enemies and loot them, explore various zones until you kill the final boss, upgrade yourself and try harder zones or difficulties (difficulties are personalizable), then repeat.

Loot

Enemies will drop loot that you can equip in 6-12 slots, each item will give different stats and they can be enchanted, enchanted items will give less stats but have spells attached to them.
Spells will synergize with your own stats and upgrades.

Upgrades

After a run, upgrade yourself in multiple Upgrade Trees, these trees will have various bonuses from small stat buffs to synergistic buffs, to powerfull buffs that add new mechanics to your character.
Some Paths will lock others, so you have to personalize your build and try to make synergies to be as powerfull as possible.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reese is a man who is uncomfortable with himself and his life. He finds escapism by reading yuri (F/F) stories on his laptop. One day while riding the subway, Lucy the witch sidles up next to him. Seeing an opportunity for mischief, she transforms Reese into a woman so he can “enjoy” this yuri content he so desperately craves—but in real-life!

Unfortunately for Lucy, Reese is ecstatic at this. Even worse, she realizes that the newly-elated Reese makes a pretty cute woman. And when Reese suddenly asks her to go shopping, Lucy can’t refuse – after all, what if Reese does something nefarious in her new body?

Genre: Yuri, Romance, Kinetic Visual Novel

Length: Around 10k words (about an hour)

Language: English

Content Warnings: Foul language, alcohol, gender dysphoria & euphoria, moths

Characters

As a man, Reese is quiet, muted, and believe he wants a relationship like the yuri stories that he reads. Reese is trying to fit a mold that he is not.

Once transformed, Reese is boisterous, happy, and willing to stand up for herself and those she cares about.

A recent graduate from Magic Caster's University, Lucy is a mischievous witch who wants to find her place in the world. When Reese enjoys being the victim of one of her curses, Lucy's reality is thrown askew.

store_data.about_the_game:
Surviving the night as a kid was always tough. If you had a nightmare, it was hard to go back to sleep. If you heard a noise, you would start to come up with the most irrational reason for the sound. However, in this case, your theories may seem less far out.
